jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Micron Technology Inc. is a world leader in innovative memory and storage solutions that help transform information into intelligence. Our technologies enable people and organizations to learn, communicate, and advance faster. We are committed to enriching life through information and supporting the digital experiences that shape the future.

Micron’s Construction & Engineering team delivers world-class facilities that support manufacturing and innovation. Working across disciplines, the team develops safe, efficient, and reliable environments where employees can do their best work. Our projects help Micron grow and operate at scale while advancing the capabilities of the semiconductor industry.

About The Role

Micron is seeking a Project Manager to lead complex construction projects from early concept through completion. You will be accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance, coordinating multidisciplinary teams to achieve agreed outcomes. This role requires a strong commitment to safety, quality, technical excellence, and proactive problem-solving throughout each project phase.

As a key partner to internal stakeholders, design teams, contractors, and suppliers, you will align people and plans, monitor progress, and address challenges before they affect delivery. Your leadership will contribute directly to the successful development of facilities that enable Micron’s continued growth and innovation.

Qualifications

Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field, or relevant professional certification or licensing.
At least five years of experience serving as the primary project manager for highly technical construction projects.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing vendors, contracts, project resources, and budgets.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use structured methods and data to inform decisions.
Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate stakeholders, resolve roadblocks, and maintain alignment across project teams.
Preferred: PMP or another recognized project management certification; experience in semiconductor or similarly complex industrial construction; and familiarity with process improvement or risk and failure mode analysis.
Preferred: A record of leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives and an interest in developing Agentic AI workflows for current or future processes.

Responsibilities

Lead assigned construction projects from planning and development through execution and closeout, managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance.
Apply Micron’s safety, environmental, and quality standards across project activities. Promote proactive hazard identification, mitigation, and resolution.
Develop and maintain project financials, including estimates, forecasts, cash flow projections, and cost controls, and communicate financial status to stakeholders.
Create and maintain detailed project schedules, track milestones, identify risks and dependencies, remove roadblocks, and coordinate cross-functional alignment.
Lead design reviews, competitive bidding, contract execution, project programming, and development activities.
Monitor project performance and take timely action to address changes, emerging issues, and delivery risks while supporting quality outcomes.

Benefits

Micron supports employee well-being and professional growth with benefits designed to promote health, provide financial protection, and help employees prepare for the future. Depending on location and eligibility, benefit offerings include choices of medical, dental, and vision plans to support employees and their families. Additional programs may include income protection for illness or injury, paid family leave, paid time off, and paid holidays. Available plans and provisions vary by location. Please refer to Micron’s benefits materials for details about programs offered in your location.

Equal Opportunity

Micron Technology Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Micron prohibits child labor and complies with applicable labor laws and standards. Micron does not charge candidates recruitment fees or request unlawful payments as a condition of employment. Applicants are encouraged to use AI tools to improve application materials, but all information must be accurate and reflect their actual skills and experience. Misrepresentation may result in disqualification. Job seekers should verify that communications and offers are authentic through Micron’s official careers website.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Client Services
jobs.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing to a case or client annual budget, consulting clients on eDiscovery best practices, and identifying preferred paths to completing projects with a focus on reducing costs, increasing speed of delivery and use of Lighthouse technologies to drive client satisfaction. Senior PMs are responsible for planning, monitoring and managing internal and external project communications of pod members. In addition, Senior PMs provide workflow consultation, drive the development of standards and participate in the daily activities associated with providing eDiscovery support to clients.

What will this person do?

Respond to client requests and provide consultation to clients to manage the scope, execution, and overall delivery of solutions that comply with industry best practices and Lighthouse Standards.
Train and develop team members on workflows and eDiscovery best practices.
Initiate work on behalf of clients by creating work orders for tasks associated with data processing, review, and production.
Communicate expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:

Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus) or equivalent experience.
6+ years of work experience with at least four years of e-Discovery project management experience.5+ years of successful experience in a law department, law firm and/or a legal consulting firm or eDiscovery provider
Relativity experience required.
Excellent eDiscovery skills needed to provide consultation and creation of client and project solutions that drive the use of technology and workflows that reduce overall client costs, improve speed, and/or deliver a higher quality product.
Knowledge of or the ability to quickly acquire a deep understanding of Lighthouse workflows, internal tools and documentation necessary to act as an internal escalation resource, and ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Strong communication skills to effectively transmit information via written (email and forms based formats ) and verbal communications to convey instructions, identify issues, propose solutions and manage conflicts between internal and external stakeholders.
Project management skills to successfully manage client relationships and execute projects to completion in order to deepen Lighthouse relationships to ensure repeat work and increased share of clients’ total spend and to gain clients’ trust as a consultant.
Flexibility and adaptability to handle a changing and growing workload.
Strong project management skills including the ability to interpret a variety of instructions provided in written and oral form.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.

This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

Lighthouse offers a quality comprehensive benefits package including, medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM)
jobs.description:
American Public Education Inc.

The Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM) is critical role within the technology and product organization team responsible for the requirements, planning and day-to-day execution of initiatives for a product line or capability within the domain and center of excellence structure. Reporting to a Product Development Manager, the TPM manages backlogs and sprints, translates business needs into clear technical requirements, and validates releases against acceptance criteria. This role unifies the responsibilities of Business Analyst and Project Manager to ensure agile, efficient delivery of high-quality technology solutions.

Responsibilities
:

Execution & Delivery:

Translate product roadmap items into actionable user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Oversee and Manage backlog refinement, sprint planning, and daily stand-ups across multiple workstreams and teams.
Track sprint velocity, capacity, and risk; escalate and provide solutions to blockers promptly.
Oversee QA testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
Champion compliance with enterprise-wide standards for accessibility, security, and data governance standards.

Analysis & Documentation:

Document workflows, business processes and rules, and system logic.
Analyze cross-product performance data and user insights to inform strategic enhancements and innovation opportunities.
Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned systems and integrations.
Support PDMs in preparing release notes, training, and stakeholder communications.

Collaboration & Improvement:

Foster strong partnerships with engineering, design, QA, and business stakeholders to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
Lead cross-functional validation efforts to ensure solutions meet business needs and user expectations.
Identify and implement process improvements that drive operational efficiency, scalability, and delivery excellence.

Continuous Improvement:

Drive continuous iterative product and process improvement through data-driven analysis and stakeholder feedback.
Identify opportunities for efficiency gains and improved workflows across the team.
Partner with domain owners and other technical leads to align on best practices and standards.

Requirements
:

5+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or project management, preferably with a technical focus.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering complex technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile/Lean practices, and technical systems ( ERP, CRM, LMS, cloud platforms, etc.).
Excellent documentation and communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
Preferred but not required, bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business, or related field.

About Us
:

Online, on campus and in the workplace, we provide higher education and training to our country’s heroes – military service members, veterans, nurses, government employees, and motivated professionals that want to make a difference. American Public Education, Inc. educates service-minded students, ranging from the military, public service, federal agencies, and nursing communities, through American Public University System (APUS), Hondros College of Nursing (HCON), and Rasmussen University.

It is the policy of American Public Education, Inc. (APEI) to afford equal opportunity to all qualified persons. We treat all qualified individuals equally as to their recruitment, hiring, assignments, advancements, compensation, and all other terms and conditions of employment. American Public Education, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, or physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

「戦略を、実行し、成果に変える。AIと共に」

顧客のDXパートナーとして、システム構想の策定から実際の導入・運用までを一気通貫でリードします。単なるツールの導入に留まらず、Salesforceを活用してお客様のビジネスを成功へ導くことが本ポジションの重要な役割となります。

本ポジションの特徴

「戦略」と「実行」の両立：アドバイザーとして、またはプライムベンダーとして、プロジェクトをサービスインまで責任を持って完遂させる役割を担います。
AIネイティブな働き方：Agentforceなどの最新AIをお客様に提案するだけでなく、自らもAIを駆使し、高い生産性と品質を兼ね備えたコンサルティングを提供します。
End-to-Endの関与：構想策定から構築、定着化まで支援するため、幅広い専門スキルを習得する機会が豊富にあります。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

具体的な担当領域：Salesforce Architectとして、専門性を活かしたコンサルティング業務を遂行していただきます。当初は以下いずれかのロールを担当していただく想定であり、入社時の役割については選考プロセスを通じて決定します。また、入社後には個々の能力を広げられる機会があり、習得したスキルに応じて多様な役割を担うことが可能です。
主なロールPM (Project Manager)：プロジェクトのリーダーとして牽引し、案件を成功に導く責任者BA (Business Architect)：ビジネス戦略、業務プロセス設計、および定着化の主導SA (Solution Architect)：アプリケーション全体設計、データモデル、標準機能活用、マルチクラウド設計の主導TA (Technical Architect)：インテグレーション、セキュリティ、システム・アーキテクチャ設計・構築、高度な技術実装の主導
主な案件 A. 戦略・変革デザイン策定（Strategy & Change Design）：組織およびシステム全体の変革構想とロードマップを策定します。組織・業務領域変革構想デザイン：業務プロセス改革や組織変革のグランドデザイン策定システム領域変革構想デザイン：ITランドスケープにおけるアーキテクチャ構想Salesforce Org 戦略：Salesforce組織（インスタンス）の活用戦略・ガバナンス戦略策定、ロードマップ策定Salesforce CTO：CTOの視点からAgentic Enterpriseへの変革を支援変革推進 / 定着化：Salesforce活用の定着化計画立案と実行支援概念実証（PoC)：具体的な解決策の設計や仮説ソリューションの実現可能性を検証
主な案件 B. プロジェクト実行・支援（Project Execution & Support）：要件定義からリリースまで、各フェーズにおいて支援または実務を遂行します。プロジェクトの特性に応じウォーターフォール型かアジャイル型を選択します。プロジェクト管理：プロジェクト計画の策定、推進、および管理支援要件定義：ビジネス要件およびシステム化要件の抽出・定義、プロセスのファシリテーション設計：アーキテクチャ・詳細設計の作成、または成果物のレビュー開発・テスト：実装・テストのリード、または開発標準策定・品質管理移行・展開：データ移行・リリースの実行、または移行戦略立案・実行支援CI/CD：DevOpsパイプラインの環境設計・構築・運用の支援
主な案件 C. ガバナンス・最適化（Governance & Optimization）Salesforce Governance：CoE（Center of Excellence）の設立、運営モデルの組成および運営支援Design Authority：設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立による設計品質の統制設計品質BestPracticeの提言・遂行支援（Design Authority）：設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立Architecture Optimization：既存環境の診断（Org診断 & ヘルスチェック）および最適化提案

You're Our Person If...

実務経験：以下の領域のいずれかにおいて、5年以上の主体的な実務経験を有すること（A. 変革デザインと戦略 / B. ガバナンスと最適化 / C. プロジェクト推進・実行）
リーダーシップ：3年以上のチームリーダー経験（立場は問わない）
コミュニケーション能力経営層を含む顧客と適切な意思疎通を図り、合意形成を推進できること関連組織のメンバーに対し、敬意を払いつつ率直かつ建設的な対話ができること
基礎理解力と学習意欲業務要件やSalesforceの技術用語、各種メソッドを短期間で理解できることAIを効率的に活用し、継続的に学習する意欲と実行力があること
マインドセット批判的思考（Critical Thinking）とアンラーニング（Unlearning）を実践できること過去の成功体験に固執しすぎず、AIなどの新技術に合わせて自らの考えや方法論を柔軟に適合できること
言語能力日本語：流暢レベル英語：英文ドキュメントの読解に支障がないレベル以上

Even Better If...

AI・データ領域の実務経験：Data 活用やAI Agentの開発など、先端技術を用いたプロジェクト経験
グローバル案件の遂行能力：英語を用いたビジネスレベルのコミュニケーションおよびプロジェクト遂行能力
AI活用による業務効率化の実績：コンサルティング業務やシステム構築において、AIを活用した生産性向上の実務経験

本ポジションで得られるキャリア価値

総合的なアーキテクトへの成長

専門的かつ幅広いスキルを習得し、市場価値の高いアーキテクトへ成長できます。

AI時代の先駆者としての経験

最新のAI活用型コンサルティング手法を実践し、最先端の知見を体得できます。

顧客の成功を通じた貢献の実感

変革の中心メンバーとしてプロジェクトを完遂させることで、顧客の成功に直接貢献できたと実感できます。

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

Lead one of Australia's most complex technology transformation programs

Join Airservices Australia and play a critical leadership role in modernising the technology that supports air traffic control across Australia's busiest airports. You'll lead the delivery of a major technology workstream within our Tower Technology Replacement Program (TTRP), helping shape the future of Australia's aviation network while working in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment.

The Organisation

Airservices Australia is a government-owned organisation responsible for the safe and efficient management of 11% of the world’s airspace and provision of aviation rescue fire fighting services at Australia’s busiest airports.

Our people are our greatest asset with a dynamic and diverse team operating from locations across the country - from bustling cities to regional and remote locations, including an island. This team keep are helping to secure the future of Australia’s skies and keep it amongst the safest in the world.

We connect people with their world safely – linking family and friends, generating economic activity, creating jobs, and facilitating trade and tourism.

Airservices is committed to fostering a culture that is diverse, inclusive, and respectful. We encourage motivated individuals who love what they do, value a service first mindset and embrace a challenge to explore a career with Airservices. In return you will be a valued team member, be offered flexibility and experience a meaningful career in an exciting, ever-evolving aviation industry.

Our Leaders

Leaders at Airservices demonstrate our Leadership Standard in the way they Know, Focus, Develop and Value our people every day. Our leaders role model our values of Safe always, Service first, Love what we do, Work as one, Own it to connect people with their world safely.

An Airservices leader leads inclusively
, thinks strategically
, collaborates
and communicates
with impact to deliver outcomes that support our culture of trust, care and accountability.

The Role & The Team

Reporting to the Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of the Voice Control Switch (VCS) project, a critical technology workstream valued between $20 million and $50 million and forming part of Airservices' broader $200 million Tower Technology Replacement Program. This role will oversee a team of project managers, engineering specialists and delivery partners responsible for upgrading critical air traffic control technology across nine of Australia's busiest airports.

You will operate within a complex stakeholder environment, partnering with engineering, safety, operations, commercial and organisational change teams while managing vendor relationships and driving program outcomes. Success will require strong leadership, influence and the ability to navigate a highly regulated environment where safety, governance and delivery excellence are paramount.

This position is available in either Melbourne or Brisbane
and is offered as a 24-month fixed-term opportunity.

Please see the link below to view the full Position Description:

The Person

This is not a step-up opportunity into a Senior Project Manager role. We are seeking an accomplished leader who can quickly establish credibility, lead multiple delivery streams and drive outcomes across a large-scale technology transformation program within a complex, regulated environment.

The Successful Applicant Will Have

Demonstrated experience leading large, complex technology, infrastructure or transformation programs valued at $20M-$50M+.
Proven capability leading other Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams to achieve program outcomes.
Experience delivering end-to-end technology initiatives incorporating engineering, organisational change management and operational readiness activities.
Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, particularly within matrixed organisations and highly regulated environments.
Demonstrated success managing delivery partners, contractors and vendors on complex transformation programs.
Recognised project or program management certification and substantial experience applying contemporary project delivery methodologies.

Candidates from sectors such as aviation, banking, critical infrastructure, defence, telecommunications, utilities or Federal Government environments will be highly regarded.

At Airservices Australia, we embrace and thrive on diversity of thought, perspectives, and capabilities because we know the benefits of having a workforce that is representative of the community that we serve. We appreciate everyone is unique, and acknowledge diversity in thought leads to greater transparency and improved consideration in our decision making.

We believe a diverse workforce supported by an inclusive culture is central to our success. We actively encourage and welcome candidates from all cultural backgrounds, gender identities, people living with disability and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply.

Security Clearance

To be eligible to apply, you must be an Australian citizen as an AIC security clearance is required for this role.

How To Apply

To apply for this position please lodge an application online before Applications close 11.55 pm (AEST) Thursday 3rd December 2026.

jobs.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2661398 Remote USA 108590009 Rev Cycle Finance Optimization Finance & Revenue Cycle

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview

The Revenue Cycle Optimization Program Manager reports to the Director of Revenue Cycle Optimization and is responsible for development and execution of optimization activities to completion. The manager will work with Revenue Cycle Leadership to identify ways to increase their net revenue, accelerate cashflow and reduce costs by addressing people, process, and technology components across the revenue cycle. The manager will employ a prescriptive and tailored approach that focuses on standard work, integrated workflow automation and technology improvements. The manager will use data and analytics to drive and recommend new initiatives to Revenue Cycle leadership and inform department priorities. The Revenue Cycle Optimization Program Manager's project scope will span across the enterprise requiring collaboration with the School of Medicine Directors of Finance and Administration, SHC, Stanford Medicine-Partners, and Tri-Valley Hospital and Ambulatory Directors, IT, as well as various SHC Revenue Cycle Leadership. The incumbent reviews, assesses, and designs workflows, as well as makes system functionality recommendations for the entire revenue cycle. . Additionally, the Revenue Cycle Optimization Program Manager ensures that all existing and new workflows are compliant and follow government, payer, and internal Revenue Cycle policies for both technical (facility) and professional policies. Other responsibilities include continuous collaborative learning and mentoring of indirect reports.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What You Will Do

Directs individuals and/or teams that lead performance improvement through lean methodology and tools for the mid-revenue cycle.
Develops and Manages improvement activities through engagement of teams, subject-matter experts, and stakeholders.
Provides leadership for large strategic initiatives, cross functional workflow issues or complex rapid improvement events for value stream analysis, standard work, improved flow, pull, waste reduction, error proofing, workplace organization, and other objectives. Identifies best counter-measures and solutions needed to address root causes.
Provides leadership to project training teams and provides mentoring support in root cause analysis, discovery workshops, and data interpretation.
Provides, leadership, subject-matter expertise, and delivery of continuous improvement practices to Revenue Cycle Leadership and staff within the organization.
Effectively creates a culture of accountability, communication, problem-solving, and resource/data effective decision-making, while keeping aligned with revenue cycle best practices.
Ensures appropriate project management, and data analytics is utilized.
Establishes baseline data for project improvement, as well as implement measures for monitoring and continues improvement. Captures ROI for all improvement initiatives.
Manages and facilitates process improvement teams and directs timely completion of multiple projects, Kaizen events, and consultative activity that support strategic goals for Revenue Cycle.
Serves as a Revenue Cycle methodology & systems expert and applies multiple performance improvement methodologies and tools to complex and cross functional solutions for resolution.
Monitors organizational KPI’s, performs operational data analysis and interprets revenue cycle initiatives to align improvement efforts with the strategic goals of the organization and department.
Promotes a culture of performance excellence, quality, high-reliability, and staff engagement.
Presents information to diverse audiences with clarity and impact. Adjusts approach to match the audience and situation.
Possesses expert leadership skills and maturity in managing difficult situations and conducting crucial conversations.
Develops executive level presentations and statuses for senior revenue cycle leadership.
Delivers presentations on Revenue Cycle programs and initiatives to a variety of audience levels
Delivers ongoing status of past and present project initiatives and impacts including realized project benefits
Participates in team intake process of project requests submitted by revenue cycle leadership for approval, benefits and prioritization. Provides feedback to Revenue Cycle leaders on project acceptance/rejection as well as recommendations for advancement as applicable.

jobs.description:
Senior Project/ Program Manager
Department:
Project & Program Management
Level:
Senior
Employment Type:
Full-time

About the company
The company is a leading blockchain infrastructure company building technology that connects blockchains with real-world data, traditional systems, and other blockchain networks. They support applications across decentralized finance, tokenized assets, interoperability, and other onchain use cases.

We are looking for an experienced Project / Program Manager
with 5+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in technology, software, fintech, blockchain, or a similarly fast-moving environment.

This role is suited to a delivery-focused programme professional who can operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to execution. You will work across engineering, product, business development, operations, commercial, and other functions to turn strategic objectives into well-defined programmes and measurable outcomes.

You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, manage complex dependencies, engage confidently with senior stakeholders, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and create the operating rhythm required to deliver programmes successfully.

The Role
As a Project / Program Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic and cross-functional initiatives.

You will operate as a central point of coordination across multiple teams, ensuring that programme objectives, priorities, dependencies, risks, resources, and timelines remain aligned.
The successful candidate will be comfortable working in an environment where requirements can evolve rapidly and where programmes may involve highly technical subject matter. You should be able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders without needing to be the technical subject-matter expert.

You will be expected to lead through influence rather than authority
, establish clarity in ambiguous situations, and ensure that teams remain focused on outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Programme Leadership
Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of complex, cross-functional programmes.
Translate strategic objectives into clear programme goals, roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and success measures.
Establish programme governance, operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and reporting structures.
Coordinate multiple interconnected projects and workstreams to ensure alignment against overall programme objectives.
Manage programme dependencies across engineering, product, operations, commercial, legal, finance, and other functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, sequence, or restructure initiatives to improve delivery outcomes.
Ensure programmes remain aligned with organisational priorities as requirements and circumstances evolve.

Delivery & Execution
Drive execution against agreed milestones, outcomes, budgets, and timelines.
Maintain appropriate programme plans, roadmaps, RAID logs, dependency maps, and decision registers.
Establish clear ownership and accountability across programme workstreams.
Identify delivery risks and issues early, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate appropriately.
Remove blockers by coordinating the appropriate stakeholders and decision-makers.
Monitor programme health and intervene when delivery is at risk.
Lead retrospectives and post-programme reviews to identify lessons learned and improve future delivery.
Establish and continuously improve project and programme management practices across the organisation.

Stakeholder Management
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and functional leaders.
Provide concise, transparent, and actionable programme reporting to leadership.
Facilitate difficult conversations around priorities, dependencies, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level and clearly communicated to affected teams.
Translate complex technical or operational information into clear business-level insights.
Align stakeholders with different objectives around common programme outcomes.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to programme sponsors and senior leadership.

Strategic Planning
Partner with leadership to define programme objectives, priorities, scope, and measures of success.
Support portfolio-level planning and prioritisation.
Identify cross-programme dependencies, resource constraints, and strategic risks.
Develop programme roadmaps that balance strategic ambition with realistic execution.
Use data, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to assess programme performance and inform decisions.
Help shape organisational processes and operating models as the company scales.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience
5+ years of professional experience in project management, programme management, product operations, consulting, technology delivery, or a related discipline.

Demonstrable experience leading complex, cross-functional programmes from initiation through delivery.
Experience working with engineering, product, technology, or other highly technical teams.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and dependencies simultaneously.
Experience operating with senior leadership and providing executive-level programme reporting.
Strong understanding of programme governance, risk management, dependency management, and delivery methodologies.
Demonstrable experience managing ambiguity and bringing structure to complex or evolving initiatives.
Demonstrable analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
Track record of influencing and driving outcomes without direct line-management authority.
Experience operating in a remote, distributed, and international organisation.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Desirable Experience

Experience within blockchain, Web3, fintech, financial services, SaaS, infrastructure, or emerging technology.
Experience working within Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery environments.
Experience with programme portfolio management.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, Asana, or equivalent platforms.
Formal project/programme management qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, AgilePM, Scrum, or equivalent is a plus
Working knowledge of blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, DeFi, tokenization, interoperability, or Web3.

Leadership & Working Style

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution
.
Creates clarity from ambiguity

You are comfortable entering situations where the objectives, ownership, requirements, or timelines are not yet fully defined. You bring structure, ask the right questions, establish accountability, and create a practical path forward.
Takes ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply managing tasks. You proactively identify risks, address issues, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
Leads through influence

You can bring together senior stakeholders, engineers, product leaders, and business teams around a common objective without relying on formal authority.
Communicates with precision

You know what different stakeholders need to know and can communicate complex information clearly, concisely, and appropriately for the audience.
Thinks strategically

You understand the relationship between individual projects and broader organisational objectives. You can move between detailed execution and high-level strategic thinking.
Challenges constructively

You are willing to challenge assumptions, question existing processes, and raise difficult issues when doing so improves the programme outcome.
Remains adaptable

The blockchain and technology landscape evolves rapidly. You can adjust plans when circumstances change while maintaining clarity around the underlying objectives.

Measures of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:
Successfully deliver complex programmes against agreed strategic objectives.
Establish clear accountability across multiple teams and workstreams.
Maintain strong programme visibility for senior leadership.
Identify and mitigate material risks before they become critical delivery issues.
Resolve complex cross-functional dependencies and unblock teams.
Improve predictability, transparency, and quality of programme delivery.
Build strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop scalable programme-management practices as the organisation grows.
Create measurable improvements in programme outcomes, operational efficiency, or organisational capability.
Become a trusted strategic delivery partner to senior leaders and programme sponsors.

What You Will Bring

You will bring the maturity to operate independently, the programme-management expertise to lead complex initiatives, and the curiosity to understand highly technical subject matter.
You don't need to be a blockchain engineer. You do need to be comfortable working alongside highly technical teams, asking intelligent questions, understanding dependencies and risks, and translating complex information into decisions and actions.
Most importantly, you will be someone who can connect strategy to execution
— turning ambitious objectives into clear plans, aligning teams around those plans, and driving delivery through to measurable outcomes.

Doodle Labs builds the connectivity backbone of the autonomous systems revolution — resilient wireless mesh networks that let drones, robots, and unmanned platforms operate reliably in the world's most demanding environments. About The Role

The Technical Project Manager runs the launch of new hardware products at Doodle Labs, from kickoff to the day they ship. You'll keep Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Sales working off one plan. Partner with Marketing and Sales on launch readiness: timing, collateral, sales training, and customer communication
Help keep product requirements and release documentation organized and current, so every team is working from the same version
Track releases and keep a clear record of what shipped, what changed, and what's coming next
Lead launch retros and keep improving how we bring products to market

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You know our product lines, how they get built, and the people behind them. You've put a working launch plan and team rhythm in place for the next hardware launch.
First 6 months: Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Sales are working from one schedule. Risks come up early, and leadership has a clear weekly view of where the launch stands.
First 12 months: You've taken a new hardware product through launch on a plan the team trusted, and we have a repeatable launch process we can use for the next one.

Who You Are

5+ years of project or program management experience
Hands-on experience launching a new hardware product as the project or program manager. You've owned the plan and coordinated Engineering, Marketing, and Operations through launch.
A working understanding of how hardware gets built: prototype builds, EVT/DVT/PVT, the hand-off to manufacturing, and supply chain lead times
Comfortable working between technical and commercial teams. You can follow an engineering conversation, turn it into a plan, and explain it in terms Sales and Marketing can use.

Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments where the plan changes and you adjust with it

Launch experience with a wireless or RF product (radios, networking gear, IoT devices, or similar), including regulatory certification like FCC or CE
Experience in drones, robotics, autonomy, or wireless networking
Experience working with OEMs, contract manufacturers, or embedded systems
Experience working with teams across time zones

See the products you help launch go out into the field and get used by people who depend on them
Collaborate with engineers and innovators building industry-leading connectivity solutions
Make a meaningful impact in a fast-growing company shaping the next generation of robotics and wireless networking

Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus One Medical, Teladoc, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Kindbody, and sponsored gym memberships

Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Forbes is seeking an Cyber Security Manager
responsible for protecting Forbes' corporate technology environment and consumer-facing digital platforms through the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls, processes, and governance. This is a hands-on technical leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Technology, with formal people-management responsibility for a small distributed team of onshore employees and offshore contractors.

This individual will own cybersecurity across two complementary domains: corporate technology security, spanning identity and access management, endpoint protection, network and cloud security, email and phishing defense, and compliance; and web platform security, spanning cloud infrastructure, source code and pipeline security, vulnerability management, and client-side protection for Forbes' digital properties. The role also serves as the governance lead for all cybersecurity matters across the organization, partnering closely with Infrastructure, Engineering, QA, Product, Legal, and Corporate Technology teams. The ideal candidate is both a technical security expert and a business-minded collaborator, capable of balancing security requirements with operational efficiency and business objectives.

This is a hybrid position based at Forbes' Jersey City headquarters, with an expectation of working in the office 2-3 days per week. Candidates should reside in New Jersey, New York, or the greater New York City metropolitan area.

Responsibilities

Leadership and Governance

Lead, mentor, and manage a distributed team of onshore employees and offshore contractors supporting corporate technology and web platform security.
Manage direct reports, goal setting, performance reviews, professional development, and day-to-day prioritization of work.
Oversee offshore contractor engagements, including deliverables, work quality, and coordination with vendor and resource management.

Support PCI and other compliance initiatives, audits, and security assessments, including evidence collection and questionnaire responses.
Maintain security metrics, reporting, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into organizational risk.
Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities, recommending improvements to strengthen Forbes' security posture.
Serve as the organization's designated HIPAA Security Officer, ensuring compliance with the HIPAA Security Rule and overseeing the protection of electronic protected health information (ePHI).

Corporate Technology Security

Administer and secure the enterprise identity and access management (SSO/MFA) platform, including authentication policies, identity lifecycle automation, and privileged access controls.
Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR) and endpoint protection across the enterprise device fleet.
Manage enterprise network security, including next-generation firewalls, switching infrastructure, and cloud network environments.
Secure the enterprise cloud identity and directory environment, including conditional access, session controls, and account hygiene.
Manage email security and phishing defense, including phishing investigation and triage, security awareness training, and phishing simulation programs.
Lead security incident investigations and response efforts, coordinating remediation and root-cause analysis activities.

Web and Digital Platform Security

Manage cloud network architecture and security controls for Forbes' consumer-facing digital platforms.
Oversee source code and development platform security, including repository access controls, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline security.
Own the vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management program across web properties and infrastructure, driving remediation with Engineering.
Lead client-side security for web properties, including governance of third-party scripts and tags and browser-side protections.
Partner with Engineering, QA, and Product teams to embed security requirements and best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
CISSP, CCSP, CISM, Security+ and/or GIAC certifications preferred.
7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including cloud security, infrastructure security, network security, or security engineering.
Experience leading and developing security engineers, including distributed and offshore team members or contractors.
Experience with the HIPAA Security Rule and protecting electronic protected health information (ePHI) is preferred
Experience managing enterprise productivity suites, identity and access management platforms, public cloud platforms, and endpoint protection and threat detection solutions.
Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, network infrastructure, and cloud networking across multiple cloud providers.
Practical experience applying AI tools to security and engineering workflows, such as automation, detection, triage, and reporting, and familiarity with governing safe AI adoption across an enterprise.
Strong scripting and automation skills for security workflow and identity lifecycle automation.
Experience supporting PCI audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
Deep understanding of identity management, privileged access controls, authentication, and authorization principles.
Skilled in leading investigations, incident response, vulnerability management, and threat analysis.
Experience developing and maintaining security policies, standards, and governance processes.
Experience partnering with legal and procurement teams on vendor security reviews and contract preparation.
Proven ability to balance strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical execution.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Full time
Hybrid/Onsite - NJ, VA, CO, FL, IN

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About This Role

As a Manager in Competitive Intelligence within our Corporate Strategy team, you will help JET see where our markets are heading and act on it. Working closely with the Head of Competitive Intelligence, senior leadership, our country and functional teams and central data colleagues, you will turn market signals into insight that leads to better decisions.

We are hiring for two Manager roles with a different emphasis.

One leans towards strategy and qualitative insight, such as spotting the macro trends shaping consumer behaviour and competition.

The other leans towards quantitative and analytical work, such as building a trusted view of market dynamics across our markets.

Both help build a faster, higher-quality Competitive & Market Intelligence (CMI) engine, and we will talk through which suits you best during the interview process. We are looking for someone who lives our behaviours of lead, deliver and care, puts our customers first and works as part of a team to get things done.

Either role can be located in Amsterdam or London.

These are some of the key components to the position:

Partner with the business - act as the Competitive Intelligence partner to country and functional leads, turning local signals into strategic insight for leadership.
Build one source of truth - create consistency across markets and a single, trusted view of market and competitive dynamics.
Spot what's next - identify the macro trends in consumer behaviour, category dynamics and competition that should shape JET's long-term strategy.
Make it actionable - translate insight into clear, concise recommendations for senior leadership.
Go deep - support the Head of Competitive Intelligence on deep-dive analyses of major competitor moves, market events and strategic questions.
Build our sources - build and maintain CMI's own qualitative sources (e.g. an expert network) to raise the speed and quality of our insight.
Automate and scale - partner with our central Data & Analytics (DNA) team on quantitative data platforms, building automation and AI tools.

What will you bring to the team?

Experience in competitive intelligence, corporate strategy or strategy consulting.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn fragmented signals and local market data into a clear, consistent, forward-looking picture.
Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative sources, with a particular strength in one and an appetite to grow in the other.
Executive presence, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and a talent for concise, compelling narratives.
A partnering mindset, building trusted relationships with country, functional and senior leaders based on respect and mutual support.
Independent, proactive and intellectually curious, following where the details and data lead.
A collaborative approach to working across a global, matrixed organisation.
Curiosity about data, automation and AI tools, and how they can raise the bar for the speed and quality of insight.

At JET, this is how we play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else are we delivering?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

Energy and Utilities

Cyber Security Analyst

Winnipeg, MB

Manitoba Hydro is consistently recognized as one of Manitoba's Top Employers!
We are a leader among energy companies in North America, recognized for providing highly reliable service and exceptional customer satisfaction. Join our team of Manitoba's best as we continue to build a company that champions safety, supports innovation, and delivers on our commitment to customer service - while actively fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace reflective of the communities we serve.

Great Benefits

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Defined-benefit pension plan for long-term financial security.
Enjoy a work schedule that typically provides every second Monday off (subject to location and operational requirements), supporting a balanced approach to work, family life and community.

Position Overview

Under the general direction of the Security Risk Management Lead, be part of a team that partners with stakeholders across Manitoba Hydro to manage cyber security risk. The position will support security programs, conduct security risk assessments and provide security guidance to project teams.

Responsibilities

Conduct security risk assessments on applications to prevent vulnerabilities and entry points that attackers can exploit.
Contribute to security risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies to resolve vulnerabilities and recommend and support security changes to system or system components as needed.
Conduct cyber security risk assessments of third-party suppliers and service providers and support the ongoing monitoring of supplier security risk throughout the contract lifecycle.
Support the alignment of cyber security risks with Manitoba Hydro's enterprise risk management framework, including rolling up assessment findings into enterprise-level cyber risk reporting.
Participate on project teams to provide security guidance and ensure security controls and requirements are ‘baked in' and addressed during the project.
Assist with the third-party Enterprise Technology Security Assessment and manage the resulting recommendations and action plans.
Direct activities of external suppliers and support establishing and overseeing monitoring, selection and termination of suppliers.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of risk management methods, templates, intake processes and supporting documentation.
Develop and maintain good working relationships with industry contacts for the purpose of information exchange and to keep abreast of technology innovation and directions. Develop and maintain good working relationships with contacts within D&T, ICS teams, and stakeholders throughout Manitoba Hydro including subsidiaries.

Qualifications

A four-year degree in Computer Science or related discipline from a university of recognized standing plus a minimum of three years related information technology (IT) or industrial control system (ICS) Support experience of which at least one year must be in a system support role;
OR
A two-year diploma in Electrical, Electronic, or Computer Technology from an institute of recognized standing plus a minimum of five years related IT or ICS Support experience of which at least three years must be in a system support role.
Entry level cyber security certification(s) with organizations such as ISACA or ISC 2 would be an asset.
General understanding of technology and how it is deployed to support the Enterprise including information technology (IT), operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems (ICS).
Knowledge of ICS Cyber Security Risk Management and NERC Critical Information Protection (CIP) Standards, Programs and Procedures, CIP infrastructure components and CIP cyber assets.
Strong oral and written communication skills and able to communicate effectively to all levels of management and staff. Demonstrated ability to build good working relationships and work effectively in team environments.
Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated creativity in resolving information technology issues, implementing new processes and products and redesigning work processes. Demonstrated focus on documentation and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated initiative, and ability to prioritize, and achieve results in a timely manner.
Possess strong analytical skills, be self-motivating, and possess mature judgment with the ability to make and implement sound decisions.
Obtain and maintain a current Personnel Risk Assessment and a "Clear" security rating in accordance with Manitoba Hydro policy P513.
NERC CIP Training is required, must be completed prior to transfer date, and renewed annually.

Salary Range

Starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The range for the classification is $40.44-$55.99 Hourly, $77,500.02-$107,279.64 Annually.

Apply Now!

Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Job Summary

Job Summary We are seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient Compliance Analyst to join our Continuous Compliance Monitor (CCM) team within the Cybersecurity GRC organization. In this role, you will help ensure that our technology environment, data practices, and security controls continuously align with internal policies and industry standards.You will leverage data analytics and automated monitoring tools to assess control effectiveness, proactively identify risks, and support continuous compliance efforts. Additionally, you will partner closely with engineering teams to embed compliance requirements into platform design and development, while delivering actionable insights that strengthen our overall cybersecurity posture.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

Compliance Controls

Control Requirements Definition: Define, map, and document comprehensive continuous compliance control requirements aligned to the organization’s cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory obligations, and internal policies.
Control Validation & Effectiveness: Continuously test and validate the design and operational effectiveness of technical controls, ensuring they mitigate risk as intended and meet compliance standards.

Platform Integration & Validation

Functional Specification Development: Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements into clear, actionable functional specifications for engineering and product teams developing internal platforms.
Platform & Release Validation: Perform rigorous pre- and post-deployment validation of platforms and system updates to ensure compliance requirements are embedded and operating effectively.

Data Analytics & Insights

Control Monitoring & Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to continuously monitor automated controls, analyze system activity, and proactively identify anomalies or control failures.
Analytical Support for GRC Initiatives: Conduct deep-dive data analysis, extraction, and manipulation to support internal audits, regulatory inquiries, and broader GRC efforts.
Data Storytelling & Reporting: Synthesize complex data into clear, compelling insights through dashboards and presentations. Communicate key trends, risk posture, and actionable recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders.

5+ years of experience owning and leading cybersecurity processes or programs, with strong expertise in cybersecurity data analysis, metrics, reporting, and using data-driven insights to improve security and compliance outcomes.

Proven ability to create clear, well-structured presentations and reports that support program objectives and key initiatives

The Security Data function is primarily responsible for overseeing daily global operations of the security master processes and associated activities for NTAM. Perform and provide subject-matter expertise for day-to-day global security master data processes across NTAM clients, accounts, and funds.

Provide project support, including requirements gathering, analysis, development of test plans, and user acceptance testing.

Respond to ad-hoc information requests and perform analysis and research in support of management, business, audit, and regulatory requests.
Support data quality management, data acquisition from third-party vendors, and ongoing system support.
Help maintain a robust governance and control framework to support the timely and accurate delivery of security data.
Lead process improvement and automation initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and operational risk management.
Maintain strong policies, procedures, and supporting documentation and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

Necessary Knowledge And Skills

Strong understanding of the investment management business and security reference data across multiple asset classes, including equities, fixed income, FX, and derivatives.

jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific. Our competitive moat is our data: the deepest, most localised company and people dataset in every market we operate in. We've proven the model in ANZ. Now we're scaling it across Southeast Asia and the US.

US reps can only sell as fast as the systems behind them. This role builds and runs the engine that turns their activity into clean, trusted pipeline.

The role

The GTM Operations Analyst
owns the tooling, data and processes our US sales team relies on every day, so pipeline is built, tracked and measured properly from day one.

This is not a ticket-taking admin role. You'll own Nooks end to end, shape account allocation, build the reporting US leadership runs on, and work with GTM Engineering to automate away rep busywork.

Reporting to the Head of Growth (Melbourne), with a strong dotted line to the VP Americas. Based in San Francisco.

About 75% hands-on execution:
tool admin, HubSpot, campaigns, reporting and rep support. About 25% process improvement:
fixing friction and rolling out new tooling.

What you'll own

US sales tooling: own and administer Nooks (configuration, users, integrations, adoption), evaluate new tools and train reps so they stick
Campaigns: build, launch and measure outbound and multi-channel US campaigns with GTM Engineering
Account allocation: keep territory and ownership rules clear, balanced and enforced in our systems
HubSpot administration: support global RevOps on properties, workflows, pipelines, reporting and users for the US team
Data integrity: keep data accurate across systems so pipeline, attribution and performance tracking can be trusted
Reporting: build the dashboards that give the VP Americas and Head of Growth a clear view of US pipeline, activity and conversion
Enablement: Notion documentation, playbooks and process fixes that remove manual work for reps
Global alignment: be the link between the US team and Australia, and support rep onboarding and lifecycle tracking

What we're looking for

Must haves

RevOps experience: around 2 years in RevOps, sales ops or GTM ops, ideally supporting an outbound team at a B2B SaaS company
Hands-on HubSpot: you've built properties, workflows, lists, pipelines and reports, not just used them
Sales engagement tool ownership: you've administered Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Lemlist or similar
Data quality instinct: you notice when numbers don't add up and fix the process, not just the record
Clear communicator: you translate between sales, marketing and technical teams, and write docs reps actually use
Self-directed across time zones: you prioritise well when the US and global teams both need you
You live and breathe AI tools. You use AI for analysis, automation, documentation and troubleshooting by default. In 2026, this is how one GTM Ops Analyst supports an entire US sales team, and you need to already be doing it.

Highly valued

HubSpot certifications
Automation tooling: n8n, Zapier or similar
Startup or scaleup background where you've had to build the standard, not inherit it

The environment

Firmable runs lean and ships fast: small senior teams, no layers, minimal process. You'll sit in San Francisco with the US sales team, working closely with Growth, GTM Engineering and RevOps in Melbourne.

We are an AI-native organisation
: AI is our default operating mode, from pipeline and data-quality analysis to automated rep workflows and agentic campaign research. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why this role

Build the US engine from the ground up: shape the systems the US sales team runs on
Real ownership: own US tooling with a direct line to the Head of Growth and VP Americas
Real career runway: grow into RevOps lead, GTM systems or US operations leadership; the ceiling is set by output, not tenure

This role probably isn't for you if

You want a ticket queue and a clear spec for every request
Fixing the record feels like enough, even when the process that broke it is still running
Reps feel like end users to manage rather than customers to serve
You do your best work inside an established RevOps function with documented systems
A manager in another time zone and a lot of autonomy sounds more stressful than exciting
AI is still on your "to learn" list rather than part of how you work every day

As a Strategic Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in optimizing product performance and operational excellence across a growing global travel business. Working at the intersection of Product and Operations, you will help ensure that new product launches deliver exceptional customer experiences while meeting business performance objectives. You will analyze operational data, customer feedback, and experiment results to identify opportunities for improvement and drive informed decision-making. Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Operations leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will translate complex insights into actionable recommendations. Position Overview

Tsunami Tsolutions is seeking Business Analysts with expertise in IFS Supply Chain Management (SCM) to support the implementation, configuration, enhancement, and optimization of IFS enterprise applications.

In this role, you will collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams to understand operational requirements, analyze supply chain processes, and develop effective ERP solutions that improve efficiency and business performance.

We are hiring across multiple levels—Business Analyst, Staff Business Analyst, and Senior Business Analyst.

Whether you are developing your ERP expertise or are an experienced IFS professional capable of leading complex functional engagements, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will vary based on the individual's experience and assigned position level.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to procurement, inventory management, material planning, and supply chain operations.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and business process workshops.
Perform fit-gap analyses to evaluate requirements against standard IFS functionality and identify opportunities for improvement.
Support the configuration, implementation, enhancement, and optimization of IFS Supply Chain Management functionality.
Analyze purchasing, supplier management, warehouse operations, inventory control, customer orders, and material planning processes.
Evaluate integrations between supply chain operations and manufacturing, maintenance, finance, and project management.
Translate business requirements into functional specifications, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with technical teams on reporting, integrations, data conversion, and application enhancements.
Develop test scenarios, execute functional testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
Assist with deployment preparation, end-user training, troubleshooting, and post-implementation support.
Identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, procurement efficiency, and operational performance.

Position Levels

We welcome candidates at different stages of their careers. The level of the position offered will reflect the individual's capabilities, relevant experience, and anticipated responsibilities.

Business Analyst

Develops functional and ERP expertise while supporting requirements gathering, process documentation, testing, and implementation activities. Works with guidance from more experienced team members and demonstrates foundational knowledge of supply chain business processes.

Staff Business Analyst

Independently manages business analysis activities, facilitates customer discussions, documents functional requirements, supports system configuration, and delivers assigned functional workstreams. Demonstrates practical knowledge of supply chain operations and ERP functionality.

Senior Business Analyst

Leads complex requirements workshops and functional workstreams, advises customers on solution design, identifies cross-functional dependencies, and mentors other Business Analysts. Demonstrates advanced knowledge of supply chain processes and experience delivering complex ERP solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Relevant experience in supply chain operations, business analysis, ERP implementation, functional consulting, or enterprise application support.
Experience with IFS Applications, IFS Cloud, or comparable ERP platforms.
Understanding of procurement, purchasing, inventory management, material planning, or related supply chain processes.
Ability to gather and document business requirements and translate operational needs into functional solutions.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience implementing, configuring, or supporting IFS Supply Chain Management functionality.
Experience with IFS Cloud or IFS Applications 10.
Knowledge of warehouse management, supplier management, customer order processing, and supply chain reporting.
Experience in aerospace and defense, aviation, manufacturing, or other supply chain-intensive industries.
Experience supporting ERP integrations, data migration, or modernization initiatives.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and requirements management tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps.

Work Location & Flexibility

Tsunami Tsolutions values collaboration and the opportunities that come from working together. Our preference is for candidates who can work in a hybrid capacity from our Glastonbury, Connecticut office, with an expectation of three days per week on-site.

We also recognize that specialized IFS expertise is not always available locally. Remote work arrangements may be considered for qualified candidates based on their experience, functional expertise, and the needs of the role.

Occasional travel to customer sites or Tsunami offices may be required based on project needs.

Target Compensation

Tsunami Tsolutions is considering candidates across multiple position levels for this opportunity. The target annual base salary ranges are:

Business Analyst - $80,000–$100,000

Staff Business Analyst - $100,000–$130,000

Senior Business Analyst - $130,000–$160,000

Individual offers will be determined based on each candidate's relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and anticipated scope of responsibilities.

Consistent with Tsunami Tsolutions' merit-based compensation philosophy, compensation recognizes individual capabilities and contributions. Higher compensation may be considered for candidates with advanced expertise who can contribute beyond the position's standard scope and assume broader responsibilities.

Benefits

Tsunami Tsolutions offers a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan terms.

Required Skills, Experience, & Abilities

Background in market research and customer insights, including working knowledge of both quantitative and qualitative methodologies.

Content auditing and large-scale tagging, with attention to detail and consistency.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Market Research Analyst with strong metadata and taxonomy skills to support a strategic knowledge management initiative focused on improving the discoverability, governance, and AI readiness of a large enterprise insights repository. This Market Research Analyst will review a library of 1,500+ market research and insights reports in Stravito and determine, based on the content, what each study is: the research type, methodology, audience, and business question it answered. They will then assess whether the current metadata and taxonomy describe those studies accurately, recommend targeted improvements, and apply them, supporting future AI-powered search, retrieval, and knowledge discovery. This is a highly hands-on role that starts with marketing research expertise. The ideal candidate can open an unfamiliar report and, without consulting others, recognize whether it is a segmentation study, social listening analysis, in-depth interview (IDI) project, brand tracker, concept test, or something else. They pair that judgment with strong metadata, content auditing, and taxonomy skills to review the current catalogue, identify errors or inconsistencies, and help fix them.

Research Classification & Methodology Recognition Responsibilities

Read and interpret 1,500+ research reports independently and identify the type of research and methodology in each (for example, segmentation, social listening, in-depth interviews (IDIs), focus groups, brand health tracking, concept or ad testing, conjoint or pricing research, ethnography, customer experience or voice-of-customer, competitive intelligence, syndicated or secondary research).
Distinguish quantitative from qualitative work, primary from secondary research, and custom from syndicated studies, using the report content (methodology sections, sample descriptions, questionnaires, and findings) rather than relying on titles or existing tags.
Capture the marketing context of each study: the business question, target audience or segment, product or brand, geography, time period, and how the findings were meant to be used.
Spot reports that were mislabeled, vaguely described, or tagged in a way that hides what the research actually is, and correct or flag them.
Build a clear reference of research types and methodologies, with plain-language definitions and examples, that the tagging approach and AI-generated tags can be checked against.
Use marketing judgment to assess the relevance, recency, and rigor of studies, informing future content quality and confidence indicators.

About The Company

Collabera is a global talent solutions company that connects professionals with leading organizations, innovative technologies, and dynamic teams. We are committed to creating opportunities for career development and meaningful work.
