In this role, you will contribute to a digital assets initiative within a corporate investment banking environment.

About The Role

Collabera is seeking a Business Analyst for a 12+ month contract supporting Corporate Investment Banking Operations in Charlotte, North Carolina. This is a hybrid position with a Monday-to-Friday schedule, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The successful candidate will work on the post-trade side of digital asset trading as the team advances into system integration testing. You will help translate business needs into clear requirements, review trade files, identify required changes, coordinate dependencies, and track testing progress and outcomes.

This role is suited to an experienced analyst who can collaborate across business and technology teams, organize detailed information, and communicate findings clearly. The Product Owner is responsible for creating Jira stories; this position focuses on analysis, coordination, file review, testing preparation, and reporting. The hourly compensation range is $70 to $73. The range reflects base compensation and may vary according to location, market conditions, experience, and candidate qualifications.

Qualifications

Candidates should have at least six years of Business Analyst experience, including demonstrated ability to capture information, elicit and document requirements, and support user acceptance testing. Experience in digital assets is required. Relevant areas may include cryptocurrency such as Bitcoin or Ethereum, distributed ledger technology, blockchain, digital asset custody, settlement, or related trading operations. An understanding of post-trade processes and the ability to review and interpret trade files will be valuable.

Applicants should be comfortable querying information with SQL and organizing or analyzing data using Excel. Experience preparing presentations or communicating results in PowerPoint is useful; familiarity with Copilot or similar productivity tools may also support reporting workflows. Strong attention to detail, clear written and verbal communication, sound organization, and the ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders are important. Candidates should be able to track dependencies, manage testing documentation, and report results accurately in a fast-moving banking environment.

Responsibilities

Gather, clarify, and document business and operational requirements for digital asset post-trade processes. Review trade files and related information to understand current workflows, identify issues, and determine what changes may be needed. Coordinate with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to track dependencies, resolve open questions, and maintain visibility into testing activities.

Support system integration testing and user acceptance testing by developing and maintaining test plans and test scripts, preparing test information, executing or coordinating test scenarios, and recording results. Track defects, exceptions, and follow-up actions, and communicate testing status and outcomes to relevant stakeholders. Use SQL to query data when needed, and use Excel, PowerPoint, and/or Copilot to organize files, analyze information, and prepare clear reports. Help ensure that requirements and testing outcomes are understood and that work remains aligned with operational needs.

Benefits

Compensation is $70 to $73 per hour, subject to applicable terms and candidate qualifications. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; and paid parking or public transportation support. Depending on eligibility and applicable policies, paid time off, paid sick and safe time, vacation, parental leave, and paid holidays may also be available. Benefit offerings and eligibility are governed by the applicable plan terms.

Equal Opportunity

Collabera is committed to fair and equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination and in accordance with applicable laws. We welcome qualified applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. To learn more about this opportunity, apply through the job posting or contact Mansi Bhatt for additional information.

Experience supporting a Department of Defense, U.S. Navy, NAVAIR, or comparable program office

Experience preparing program reports, briefings, meeting materials, schedules, milestone trackers, or action-item logs

Services-oriented architecture / microservices
Multi-tier applications (presentation tier/services-processing tier/data management tier)
Enterprise and vendor API integration
Managing system behavior through configurable variables
Error handling
XML and JSON data structures

Ability to write SQL queries
Problem solving skill – Works well under pressure and challenges, team-player, good listener, analytical, creative, approachable, etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to partner with various levels of leadership within the organization
Conducting complex technical analysis across multiple products
Work in Agile methodology
Writing requirements for a system
Writing front end mobile and/or web application requirements is a plus
Writing back end service requirements is a plus
Experience using tools such as Postman or SoapUI to exercise APIs is a plus

Digital Technical Analysis Contractor Role Clarifications 2026-11-13

Front-End Analysis Experience
Analysts must do more than describe front-end behavior, such as display and navigation results from user actions. They must also define the technical orchestration those actions trigger: service calls (specific endpoints), error and partial-success handling, dynamic content, analytics tagging, and conditional display.
Back-End Analysis Experience
Analysts must do more than test and validate API requests and responses in a tool such as Postman. They must also define the requirements for service behavior: data retrieval, interactions with other services, business logic and rules, data transformations, response object mapping, and logging or events generated from the outcome.
Analysts should be able to independently research enterprise and vendor APIs to find data sources for new functionality, or to document the changes existing APIs need to support it.
Architectural Understanding
Analysts should understand the differences between the presentation tier, middle service tier, and data tier, and how best to distribute functionality across them, especially in a multi-channel application.
Not required, but helpful: If analysts know the difference between native mobile apps and responsive websites that adapt to mobile screens.
Analysts should have an intuitive sense of when to check whether existing reusable components could be used, so new functionality isn't built redundantly.
Documentation
Technical User Stories: Analysts should be able to understand and write Gherkin acceptance criteria that include technical details, such as service behavior and endpoints and any other relevant technical details.
Living Technical Specifications: Analysts should be able to maintain documentation for each capability and update it continuously as functionality changes.
Collaborative Knowledge Management: Analysts should have experience documenting in a wiki format with a tool such as Azure DevOps or Confluence.

+ Must Have's:

Experience capturing technical requirements for information systems/applications

Experience working with APIs

Familiarity with multi-tier applications (application layer, services layer, data layer)

+ Nice to Have's:

Experience using tools such as Postman or SoapUI to exercise APIs

Experience in the financial industry

Experience working on requirements for native mobile applications

jobs.title: All-Source Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Number: R0253811

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our defense policymakers.

As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission and operational landscape. You’ll validate information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for DoD customers. This is a chance to grow your expertise and develop new skills in strategic all-source regional analysis to inform DoD customers and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation's leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

2+ years of experience with research and analysis
Experience with the CENTCOM or AFRICOM AOR
Experience with ICD 203 tradecraft standards
Knowledge of the DoD, wider IC, and Combatant Command environments
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
HS diploma or GED and 6+ years of experience with all-source analysis, Associate's degree and 4+ years of experience with all-source analysis, or Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience with all-source analysis

Nice If You Have:

4+ years of experience as a strategic all-source intelligence analyst
Experience with data analytics, analysis, and visualization
Experience with C4I analysis and C4I tools such as MIDB and MARS
Knowledge of the intelligence cycle
Ability to display a willingness to learn
Possession of excellent interpersonal skills
Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including briefing

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

jobs.title: DTP & E-learning Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DTP & E-learning Project Manager based in United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on DTP & E-learning Project Manager to oversee multilingual desktop publishing and e-learning localization projects in an international environment. In this role, you will manage the entire production lifecycle, from initial file preparation and cost estimation to resource coordination, production, linguistic validation, and final quality assurance. You will take ownership of delivery standards, ensuring localized content is accurate, visually consistent, and ready for client use. Combining strong technical expertise with project management capabilities, you will work directly with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and clients to ensure smooth project execution. You will also troubleshoot complex formatting and localization challenges, providing practical solutions while maintaining quality and deadlines. This is a six-month, fully remote opportunity suited to a proactive professional who enjoys combining technical production work with project coordination and client-facing responsibilities.

Accountabilities

Manage the complete DTP and e-learning localization workflow, including pre-flight checks, file preparation, quotation, resource allocation, production, linguistic sign-off, and final delivery.
Assess incoming files and prepare them for translation and localization, identifying potential technical or formatting issues before production begins.
Estimate project costs, resource requirements, and production timelines based on file complexity, language combinations, and script requirements.
Coordinate and delegate DTP and e-learning production tasks to internal teams and external vendors, providing clear instructions, deadlines, and quality expectations.
Oversee multilingual DTP production, ensuring accurate formatting, layout consistency, font compatibility, and appropriate handling of text expansion across different languages and writing systems.
Work hands-on with source files to troubleshoot and resolve complex formatting, layout, and technical issues whenever necessary.

It’s nice to be able to say things like that but we’re not patting ourselves on the back just yet. We want to show everyone that it’s possible to be a successful business while looking after people and the planet too, so we’re trying to get better in pretty much every way. And that’s where this job comes in.

A little background

At innocent, data helps us make better decisions about our drinks, our operations, and how we grow the business responsibly. Our Business Analysts play a big role in this, partnering with teams across the business to turn questions into insights and insights into action.

This advert isn’t for a specific open role right now. Instead, it’s our way of meeting curious, analytical people who’d like to be part of innocent in the future. We’re building a talent pool
for Business Analyst roles across different levels. From those starting out in their analytics journey to more seasoned analysts looking for their next challenge. This is open to all levels and when a role comes up we’ll match applications.

If you like solving meaningful problems, asking good questions, and working with humans as much as numbers, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be

Want to hear how this looks in practice? Business Analysts at innocent often:

Partner with teams across the business to understand challenges and turn them into clear problems and requirements
Analyse data, processes and systems to uncover insights, opportunities and risks
Shape solutions by thinking across people, process, technology and data
Create clear documentation, process maps, and analysis that help drive decisions
Support or lead delivery across the full project lifecycle, from early concept through to rollout
Work closely with project teams, engineers, subject matter experts and third‑party partners
Contribute to testing activities, making sure changes work as expected and issues are resolved
Help land change effectively through training, communication and ongoing support
Track progress, manage risks and dependencies, and help keep work on track
Work with various tools like Azure and Lucid Chart, and work with systems like Dynamics 365 and Kinaxis Maestro.

Depending On Your Level, You Might Also

Lead end‑to‑end analysis on complex projects
Influence senior stakeholders and shape decision‑making
Improve ways of working, governance and delivery standards
Coach or support more junior analysts

You’ll have

Here’s what we’re looking for in our Business Analysts:

A strong analytical mindset and curiosity for understanding how things work
Experience working with data, processes or systems (this can look different depending on your level)
The ability to turn complex information into clear, thoughtful recommendations
Confidence working with stakeholders and adapting your style to different audiences
A practical, problem‑solving approach and a desire to make things better
Attention to detail, with the ability to see things through from idea to delivery
Comfort using tools (e.g. Excel, reporting tools, systems) and a willingness to keep learning

For More Experienced Roles, We’ll Also Look For

Experience delivering change end‑to‑end across projects or programmes
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work through ambiguity
Experience supporting or developing others

You'll get

The chance to be considered first for future Business Analyst roles at innocent
Work with a variety of teams on many different projects. Keeping you learning non-stop.
A role where insights genuinely influence decisions, not just slides
Support to grow your skills, whether you’re deepening your technical toolkit or your commercial thinking
The opportunity to do work that supports a business trying to leave things a little better than it found them

We want innocent to be a great place to work, so we do lots of stuff to make people feel at home and try to make sure everyone’s career is shaping up the way they want it to. There are plenty of opportunities to have a go at something new or take things further.

In exchange for helping us do business in the right way, you’ll get a solid rewards package that includes a salary (phew), private healthcare, a target-based bonus, and a bunch of other nice things like a day off on your birthday. And yes, you get free smoothies.

We also know that not all our drinkers come from the same background, or think the same – so why should we? At innocent, we want to be a great place to work where a diverse bunch of people from all backgrounds can turn up and thrive. When we hire, we want all the juice, bits, and pulp that make you who you are.

Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

Varda is seeking a Program Operations Manager
to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for all program reporting for cost and schedule. The scope spans Varda's operations as the company scales toward 12+ vehicles per year. You will own scheduling through the entire program life cycle, from baseline development through execution, change management, and closeout. You will work cross-functionally with Vehicle Systems, Integration and Test, Supply Chain, Production, Finance, and Mission Assurance to turn scope into executable plans.

This is a newly consolidated function. Beyond running the schedule, you will stand up the program controls reporting that replaces status collected by email. You will define the metrics the company manages to, and set the structure that lets cost and schedule tie together as Varda's contracting model matures. You will also set the standards the scheduling team works to, and direct the application engineers and data engineer who build the systems behind your reporting. Projects will include a wide range of desired outcomes, including cycle time reduction, improved decision-making, risk reduction, data quality, and defensible, audit-ready schedules.

This role will report to the Director of Enterprise Applications, with a dotted line to Program Management. Two contractor schedulers will report to you.

Responsibilities

Own the integrated master schedule (IMS) across all Varda operations, including critical path, near-critical activities, and key schedule drivers.
Run the weekly schedule cadence of status collection, forecast adjustment, and publish, communicating risks, impacts, and recovery options.
Set the DCMA-based health standard a schedule passes before it publishes, keeping schedules defensible and audit-ready.
Own baselines, re-baselining, engineering change cut-ins, and the impact analysis on schedules and operations.
Own the integration architecture across IMS, MRP, PLM, and ERP.
Define the program and scheduling requirements that drive MRP and ERP selection, configuration, and implementation.
Lead the program side of an MRP replacement, from vendor evaluation through data migration, validation, and cutover.
Own the scheduling toolset roadmap and partner with Application Engineers on build priorities.
Coordinate need dates and planning parameters with Supply Chain to initiate risk mitigations like long lead orders.
Co-develop with finance the work breakdown structure and control account coding to support government contracting.
Assist the VP, W-Series Vehicles and Finance with monthly earned value metrics, including mission-related spend and non-recurring and recurring engineering labor
Build the KPI and dashboard suite that replaces status collected by email, and own the metric definitions and thresholds behind it.
Set the standard for identifying and dispositioning the data quality issues that distort metrics.
Own programmatic risk and its tracking, with Mission Assurance owning technical risk.
Manage and grow the scheduling team, setting shared scheduling standards and the staffing plan as the function scales.

Basic Qualifications

B.S. or M.S. with emphasis in Project Management or related field.
8+ years of experience in mission, space vehicle, or production scheduling.
Expertise in schedule management tools, including MS Project and Smartsheet.
Direct experience integrating a scheduling tool with an MRP or ERP system (SAP, Costpoint, Oracle, ION).
Proficiency building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Smartsheet, or equivalent business intelligence tooling.
Experience leading schedulers, planners, or contractors.
Experience replacing manual status reporting with systems generated KPIs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross functional environment.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience in a fast paced aerospace or technology startup environment.
Background in space or aviation hardware production.
Familiarity with streamlined earned value management methods and tools.
Experience standing up a scheduling or program management function from scratch.
Experience building program controls structures that support cost-plus or government contract reporting requirements.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Fleet Data & Operations Analyst
Job Description

The Fleet Data & Operations Analyst supports sales forecasting, business analysis, financial reporting, incentive administration, and executive reporting for fleet operations. This early-career analytical role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying trends, solving problems, and transforming information into clear business insights. The position primarily supports fleet analytics and planning, and includes cross-training to provide backup support for critical vehicle ordering and tracking activities.

Responsibilities

Support monthly sales and production forecasting by analyzing key business data.
Analyze customer demand, sales, inventory, and production trends to inform decision-making.
Compare actual performance to forecasts and customer commitments, highlighting variances.
Identify trends, exceptions, and potential business risks and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses for fleet leadership and management.
Support customer and vehicle profitability analysis to optimize incentive strategies.
Prepare incentive calculations and supporting documentation with a high level of accuracy.
Validate incentive payment data, identify discrepancies, and work to resolve issues.
Assist with incentive reconciliation and approval processes to ensure timely payments.
Support monthly financial and business performance reporting across fleet operations.
Prepare and maintain Excel-based reports and management dashboards for key stakeholders.
Support existing Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, and other reporting tools.
Consolidate data from internal systems, vendors, and other sources into usable formats.
Validate data quality and resolve reporting discrepancies to maintain data integrity.
Identify opportunities to simplify, streamline, or automate recurring reports and dashboards.
Provide backup support for vehicle order placement and allocation during peak periods and critical deadlines.
Assist with production coordination to ensure orders are aligned with manufacturing schedules.
Support VIN and vehicle status tracking to keep stakeholders informed of order progress.
Participate in order reconciliation activities to ensure accuracy between systems and records.
Prepare customer and management status reporting related to order lifecycle activities.
Balance analytics and reporting responsibilities with order lifecycle backup support, which is expected to represent approximately 15 to 20 percent of the role.

Essential Skills

Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
1 to 3 years of experience in analytics, finance, operations, reporting, supply chain, or a related function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work with large datasets and identify trends, patterns, or inconsistencies.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical and technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, or similar reporting tools.
Experience with Power Query or other data transformation tools.
Exposure to forecasting, financial analysis, or operational reporting.
Experience creating dashboards or recurring management reports.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Recent graduates with relevant internship, academic, or project experience will be considered.
Automotive or fleet industry experience is helpful but not required.
Experience in data entry and data analysis within a business environment.
Background in analytics forecasting and reporting dashboards.
Ability to support order lifecycle processes, including vehicle ordering, tracking, and reconciliation.
Interest in developing deeper experience with Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, forecasting, financial analysis, and automotive operations.

Work Environment

This position is based in Torrance and operates in a professional office environment focused on fleet operations, analytics, and reporting. The role involves extensive work with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and business intelligence tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, and Power Query. The analyst collaborates with cross-functional teams and supports critical order lifecycle activities during peak periods and key deadlines. Standard business hours are typical, with occasional flexibility needed to meet reporting timelines and operational needs. Business-appropriate attire is expected in the workplace.

jobs.title: DTP & E-learning Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DTP & E-learning Project Manager based in France.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on DTP & E-learning Project Manager to oversee multilingual desktop publishing and e-learning localization projects in an international environment. In this role, you will manage the entire production lifecycle, from initial file preparation and cost estimation to resource coordination, production, linguistic validation, and final quality assurance. You will take ownership of delivery standards, ensuring localized content is accurate, visually consistent, and ready for client use. Combining strong technical expertise with project management capabilities, you will work directly with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and clients to ensure smooth project execution. You will also troubleshoot complex formatting and localization challenges, providing practical solutions while maintaining quality and deadlines. This is a six-month, fully remote opportunity suited to a proactive professional who enjoys combining technical production work with project coordination and client-facing responsibilities.

Accountabilities

Manage the complete DTP and e-learning localization workflow, including pre-flight checks, file preparation, quotation, resource allocation, production, linguistic sign-off, and final delivery.
Assess incoming files and prepare them for translation and localization, identifying potential technical or formatting issues before production begins.
Estimate project costs, resource requirements, and production timelines based on file complexity, language combinations, and script requirements.
Coordinate and delegate DTP and e-learning production tasks to internal teams and external vendors, providing clear instructions, deadlines, and quality expectations.
Oversee multilingual DTP production, ensuring accurate formatting, layout consistency, font compatibility, and appropriate handling of text expansion across different languages and writing systems.
Work hands-on with source files to troubleshoot and resolve complex formatting, layout, and technical issues whenever necessary.
Manage e-learning localization projects, ensuring that localized training materials function correctly and maintain their intended structure and user experience.
Conduct quality assurance checks throughout the production process, including linguistic validation, document formatting, and final file verification.
Advise internal stakeholders on localization best practices, file preparation requirements, and efficient production workflows.
Act as a subject-matter expert in DTP and e-learning localization, participating in client discussions and providing technical recommendations when required.
Monitor project progress, proactively identify delivery risks, and implement solutions to maintain deadlines and quality standards.
Provide constructive feedback to vendors and production teams to continuously improve delivery quality and operational efficiency.

Requirements

At least 4 years of professional experience in multilingual DTP and e-learning production within the localization industry.
A demonstrable portfolio showcasing experience delivering multilingual files for real clients and managing the associated production workflows.
At least 2 years of experience scoping, estimating, quoting, and coordinating complex DTP and e-learning localization projects.
Advanced knowledge of multilingual publishing requirements, including Latin, Cyrillic, right-to-left (RTL), and Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) scripts, with practical delivery experience or a credible vendor coverage strategy.
Strong understanding of localization best practices, including translation-ready file preparation, text expansion management, font coverage, and linguistic review processes.
Proven ability to estimate production time and costs per file, language, and writing system, with clear assumptions and resource planning.
Expert-level proficiency in e-learning authoring tools, particularly Articulate Rise and Storyline.
Advanced technical skills with Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, and ideally FrameMaker.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, including document formatting and layout management.
Experience managing external DTP vendors, including task delegation, production briefings, deadline management, quality reviews, and feedback.
Ability to troubleshoot technical and formatting issues independently, anticipate potential challenges, and propose effective solutions.
Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate clearly in client-facing documentation, technical guidance, and internal project handoffs.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.
A proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset, with the confidence to challenge unrealistic requirements while maintaining a collaborative approach.
Familiarity with formatting and document production requirements for life sciences content is an advantage.

Additional Qualifications Considered a Plus

Experience working with Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD source files.
Familiarity with computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools and translation management systems, particularly file preparation and format round-tripping workflows.
Knowledge of automation techniques, including InDesign scripting, GREP styles, and data merge.
Understanding of PDF accessibility standards, tagging, and accessible document production.
Practical experience working with Thai or Indic writing systems.

Benefits

Six-month, full-time, fixed-term contract.
Fully remote working arrangement, offering location flexibility across Europe.
Opportunity to work on international multilingual localization and e-learning projects.
Hands-on involvement in a varied range of DTP, digital learning, and document production activities.
Opportunity to combine technical production expertise with project management and client-facing responsibilities.
Collaboration with internal teams and specialized external vendors in an international localization environment.
Opportunity to contribute to production best practices, workflow improvements, and quality standards.
Exposure to a diverse range of languages, scripts, industries, and localization technologies.

jobs.title: Program Manager (French Speaking), Amazon Music International Product
jobs.description:
Description

Français:

Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres: les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement; les clients peuvent opter pour Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres, dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities

Français

Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.
Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.
Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.
Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations

avec les artistes et les labels.

Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.
Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English

Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.
Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.
Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.
Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.
Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.
Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.
AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

jobs.title: AGUN Transition Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Transition Program Manager – Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)

Program:
Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)

Work Location:
Remote | Travel Required as Needed-*Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.

Clearance Required:
Active Secret

Citizenship:
U.S. Citizenship Required

Lead the Transition of the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking an experienced Transition Program Manager
to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)
program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize the Army's global network infrastructure and ensure new technologies and network capabilities are successfully transitioned into operational support.

In this role, you'll lead complex technical transition projects, coordinate engineering and operations teams, and manage the successful handoff of new systems from implementation into ongoing operations.

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical program management skills, experience leading cross-functional teams, and a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and network operations
.

This is more than a traditional project management role. We need a leader who understands technical transitions, can resolve complex challenges, and ensures new capabilities are fully operational before handoff.

What You'll Do

Lead and manage technical transition projects supporting the Army's global network modernization efforts.
Oversee transition activities from planning and implementation through testing, validation, and operational handoff.
Coordinate across Network Engineering, Migration, Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, Operations, and Program Management teams.
Develop and manage transition plans, schedules, milestones, risk registers, and readiness assessments.
Establish clear roles and responsibilities using RACI matrices, including operational ownership, decision authority, and escalation procedures.
Ensure new network technologies and capabilities are successfully transferred into steady-state operations and sustainment.
Lead technical teams, coordinate resources, and ensure project milestones and deliverables are completed on schedule.
Identify and resolve technical risks, system dependencies, integration challenges, and operational issues.
Work with government stakeholders, Task Order Managers, technical leads, and subcontractors to align priorities and resolve challenges.
Support resource planning, staffing coordination, budget tracking, and project performance monitoring.
Conduct transition readiness reviews, operational assessments, and lessons-learned sessions.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and executive-level reports to track transition progress, performance, and operational readiness.
Support process improvements, change management, and technology modernization initiatives.
Ensure transition activities meet DoD cybersecurity, quality, and program requirements.
Provide regular technical and program status updates to Leidos leadership and government customers.

What We're Looking For

Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor's degree in a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
2+ years of experience leading or supervising technical teams, projects, or engineering initiatives.
Experience managing complex IT service transitions, operational handoffs, or transfers of technical responsibility.
Experience leading technical programs, systems integration projects, network modernization initiatives, or complex IT engineering efforts.
Experience developing transition plans, project schedules, milestones, risk registers, action trackers, and RACI matrices.
Experience coordinating with DoD or Federal Government customers on transition deliverables, readiness reviews, and acceptance activities.
Strong understanding of technical project management, resource planning, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
Working knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure, network architecture, systems engineering, or hardware/software integration.
Familiarity with ITIL, IT Service Management (ITSM), and service transition best practices.
Experience managing project budgets, resources, and performance metrics.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive results without direct supervisory authority.
Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced technical environment.
Ability to work remotely and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or PgMP certification.
Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other large DoD network modernization programs.
Experience with network migrations, systems integration, and operational sustainment transitions.
Familiarity with Army enterprise network operations and global communications infrastructure.
Experience with technical architecture reviews, engineering change management, and systems integration.
Knowledge of advanced analytics, machine learning, intelligent automation, or network automation.
Experience with Agile methodologies, portfolio management, and organizational change management.
Experience supporting contract management, resource forecasting, and subcontractor coordination.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity requirements and compliance standards.
Experience developing executive dashboards, technical performance metrics, and operational readiness reports.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll play a key role in modernizing the U.S. Army's global network infrastructure while helping ensure new technologies are successfully integrated and ready to support critical military operations.

You'll work with experienced technical teams, collaborate with government stakeholders, and lead complex transition initiatives that directly contribute to mission success.

If you're an experienced Technical Program Manager who understands enterprise IT transitions, network modernization, and operational readiness, we want to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help drive the next generation of Army network modernization. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

November 18, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA is seeking an Associate Project Manag
er to provide project implementation support for a VA logistics software application on the Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program. Working under the direction of a senior team member, the Associate PM will help plan, coordinate, and track the activities needed to deploy new capabilities and keep the application running. These activities include release and deployment planning, site and user readiness, training, go-live support, and post-implementation follow-up. This role suits an early-career professional who is organized, communicates clearly, and wants to grow in federal health IT implementation and project management.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA
associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!

Responsibilities

Implementation Planning and Coordination

Assist in developing and maintaining implementation plans, deployment schedules, cutover plans, and milestone trackers for patches, releases, and modernization increments.
Coordinate implementation activities among MUMPS developers, Java/React developers, business analysts, testers, infrastructure and operations teams, and VA stakeholders.
Track tasks, dependencies, and deliverables, and follow up with team members to resolve blockers before deployment dates.
Schedule and facilitate implementation meetings, readiness checkpoints, and go/no-go reviews, and capture agendas, minutes, decisions, and action items.
Support resource planning and capacity tracking in coordination with team leads.

Deployment, Release, and Go-Live Support

Coordinate patch and release schedules with operations, testing, change management, and facility or site points of contact.
Help prepare and track release readiness checklists, change requests, deployment runbooks, and rollback plans.
Support go-live activities, including communication of deployment windows, real-time status tracking, and issue escalation.
Capture post-deployment results, lessons learned, and follow-up actions, and report them to the senior PM and product owner.
Track incident, defect, and enhancement ticket volumes and aging after deployment to identify implementation-related issues and trends.

Modernization Implementation Support

Monitor progress of modernization work streams, including API development, UI development, authentication integration, and data migration, and flag schedule or scope concerns that could affect implementation.
Support coordination of integration, environment, and testing activities across teams and external VA partners.
Track transition tasks that move users and functions from legacy components to modernized ones, and help manage related dependencies.

Risk, Issue, and Reporting Management

Maintain the risk, issue, assumption, and dependency (RAID) logs for implementation activities, and escalate items as appropriate.
Prepare weekly status reports, dashboards, and metrics (e.g., milestone status, deployment success rates, burn-down) for project leadership.
Assist with budget and invoice tracking, level-of-effort reporting, and contract deliverable monitoring as needed.

Agile and Governance Support

Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, and maintain Jira boards and Confluence pages.
Help prepare project artifacts required by VA software development lifecycle processes and team procedures
Maintain a well-organized project repository of plans, decisions, and records.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience may substitute on a year-for-year basis.
3 years of experience in project coordination, implementation support, project management support, or a related role.
Basic understanding of project management concepts, including scope, schedule, risk, and communication management.
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum concepts and with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or similar.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.
Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Ability to obtain and maintain the required background investigation and favorable suitability determination.
U.S. citizenship or the work authorization required by the employer or contract.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting software or IT implementations, deployments, or rollouts, ideally in healthcare or federal government settings.
Familiarity with VA or VHA programs, VistA, or health IT concepts. Experience with a legacy-to-modern system migration or application modernization effort.
Basic understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD, APIs, change management, and release management.
Experience developing training materials, user communications, or end-user support processes. Experience preparing status reports, dashboards, and executive briefings.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Information Systems, Project Management, or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

Clearance

Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Background Investigation (VA Handbook 0710); ability to obtain VA PIV credential.

Location:

Work location and schedule (remote) to be specified upon hire.

Pay Range

The suggested pay for this position ranges from $46,546 to $111,875.
The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

jobs.title: Estimator/Project Manager
jobs.description:
A well-established specialty contractor is looking for a construction professional who knows drywall inside and out and wants to own a job from the first set of plans to the final walkthrough. You'll price the work, win it, and then help deliver it, so the numbers you build are the ones you'll see on the jobsite.

If you're an estimator who's tired of handing off your bids and never seeing how they turn out, or a project manager who wants more say in what gets bid, this role gives you both.

What You'll Do

Win the work

Review drawings and specs, flag conflicts and gaps, and get answers before pricing goes out
Perform quantity takeoffs and break out labor, materials, and equipment, organized the way each customer wants to see it
Build bids that reflect real production rates, sequencing, schedule, and safety conditions
Work with project managers and subcontractors to check manpower assumptions and vendor pricing
Look for value engineering options that help the company stay competitive without cutting corners or code compliance
Write clear proposals and present them to customers with confidence
Juggle several bids at once without missing deadlines

Deliver the work

Confirm contract terms after award and walk the project team through the estimate in a turnover meeting
Help build job cost budgets and buy out materials and subcontractors
Support change orders and keep an eye on progress against the budget
Join post-job reviews to capture what went well and what to change on the next bid

Required

What you bring

Experience in construction estimating, project management, or both, ideally on the drywall or interior finishes side
Working knowledge of construction methods, building codes, and quantity takeoff techniques
Ability to read plans and specs closely and catch problems others miss
Sound judgment on pricing and risk
Clear written and verbal communication
Strong organization when juggling deadlines
Comfort with estimating and takeoff software
A degree in construction technology or a related field, or equivalent training and hands-on experience

A Strong Plus

Experience with metal deck or rainscreen systems
Past experience on commercial or institutional projects
Experience with bid platforms and project cost tracking tools

What Makes Someone Successful Here

You're someone who builds trust with general contractors, subcontractors, and architects, adjusts quickly when scope or priorities change, and wants your fingerprints on both the bid and the build.

Resumes can be confidentially submitted to matt.schmidt@gogpac.com

jobs.title: Program Manager, Environmental Engineer
jobs.description:
Find your path and enjoy the journey at Haley & Aldrich
. With us, you’ll tackle clients’ most meaningful challenges in the built and natural environments – and, in turn, build stronger communities. You’ll work with teams of passionate colleagues, driven by a commitment to technical excellence and continuous learning.

As a company, we aim to build a world where communities go beyond resilience, embracing change as an opportunity to enhance safety, well-being, and quality of life. Join us to accelerate this vision and your professional development.

We are looking to add new talent to our growing team! We are currently seeking a Program Manager, Environmental Engineer
to work in a technical lead role with highly skilled professionals on diverse project teams in a dynamic environment. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing group and company and get involved in a variety of projects for a diverse range of clients. This is a full-time, local hybrid
position located in out Walnut Creek, Oakland, or San Jose, CA
office.

Duties/Responsibilities

In this position, you will:

Draw from your diverse experience to lead some of our most complex projects and programs and lead teams of project managers and technical experts with a focus on delivery, quality, financial performance, and health and safety.
Lead the development of team technical competence, knowledge of guidance and regulations, and professional standards of practice to assigned tasks.
Balance management responsibilities with technical strategy and client advocacy, ensure project delivery aligns with professional standards and client expectations, and develop strong client relationships.
Hold primary responsibility for the success of programs including contract negotiations, pricing, structure and processes, project planning and execution, resourcing, schedule, and financial management.
Collaborate closely to support project teams, providing oversight, observing health and safety processes and procedures, and developing a working understanding of our various consulting practice areas.
Regularly and effectively communicate with clients, partners, subcontractors, regulators and other stakeholders.
Regularly direct, coach, and support staff to ensure high-quality project execution, focusing on developing team skills for professional growth and delivering comprehensive technical reports and deliverables.
Apply situational leadership and emotional intelligence to facilitate management of diverse stakeholders and team members.
Plan and direct complex field investigation programs, including pre-design data collection and/or pilot testing data collection programs.
Lead large technical evaluations and design efforts, including conceptual site model development, field implementation of bench-scale and field pilot studies, remedial action plans, remedial system installation and O&M, permitting, design and contract package development, construction procurement support for environmental projects; may function as the Engineer of Record.
Ensure that all work is performed in accordance with company and client health and safety protocols.
Demonstrate the company’s foundational safety behaviors.

Skills/Experience

Minimum Skills and Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering or related field.
16+ years of related Bay Area environmental remediation consulting work experience including direct project management experience.
Professional registration or certification, PE.
Experience with the preparation of design plans, permit applications and technical specifications for remediation of San Francisco Bay Area contaminated sites, including earthwork and site/civil aspects of remedial construction projects.
Demonstrated experience in all phases of investigation and remediation process.
Ability to independently lead multi-disciplinary project teams to achieve project and client goals and objectives.
Strong organizational skills, attention to details, and financial acumen.
Strong staff management and mentoring skills
Proficient computer literacy skills including use of the Microsoft Office 365 Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint) and the ability to learn various software needed to support financial management, diverse project needs, and client requirements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Broad environmental engineering experience that spans the entire project life cycle.
Demonstrated competency with various environmental regulatory frameworks.
Demonstrated competency and understanding of soil, groundwater and air treatment technologies.

Preferred Skills

Master’s degree in Environmental Engineering or related field.
6+ years of project management and financial management experience.
Proficient with Microsoft Project.
Design and construction experience with environmental remediation projects.
OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER training and refresher updates.

The salary range for this position in Walnut Creek, Oakland, or San Jose, CA
is $170,000-$200,000
. Actual compensation will be based upon a variety of factors such as education, related work experience, certificates, skills, and current market conditions. Haley & Aldrich reviews salary ranges each quarter to assess competitiveness with the market.

About Haley & Aldrich

Haley & Aldrich is committed to delivering the value our clients need from their capital, operations, and environmental projects. Our team of 1,000+ engineers and scientists across the United States draw inspiration from one mission: to work closely with clients as they navigate change to create safer, more robust places to live and work. Since our founding in 1957, organizations across the public and private sectors have relied on us for technical excellence and empathetic leadership that achieve results and secure a thriving tomorrow. Learn more at haleyaldrich.com.

Haley & Aldrich is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, age, disability, veteran, or any other legally protected status. We offer excellent career growth, a highly competitive total compensation plan, and a solid benefits package. Interested candidates should apply on our Careers page.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

「戦略を、実行し、成果に変える。AIと共に」

顧客のDXパートナーとして、システム構想の策定から実際の導入・運用までを一気通貫でリードします。単なるツールの導入に留まらず、Salesforceを活用してお客様のビジネスを成功へ導くことが本ポジションの重要な役割となります。

主な案件 B. プロジェクト実行・支援（Project Execution & Support）：要件定義からリリースまで、各フェーズにおいて支援または実務を遂行します。プロジェクトの特性に応じウォーターフォール型かアジャイル型を選択します。プロジェクト管理：プロジェクト計画の策定、推進、および管理支援要件定義：ビジネス要件およびシステム化要件の抽出・定義、プロセスのファシリテーション設計：アーキテクチャ・詳細設計の作成、または成果物のレビュー開発・テスト：実装・テストのリード、または開発標準策定・品質管理移行・展開：データ移行・リリースの実行、または移行戦略立案・実行支援CI/CD：DevOpsパイプラインの環境設計・構築・運用の支援
主な案件 C. ガバナンス・最適化（Governance & Optimization）Salesforce Governance：CoE（Center of Excellence）の設立、運営モデルの組成および運営支援Design Authority：設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立による設計品質の統制設計品質BestPracticeの提言・遂行支援（Design Authority）：設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立Architecture Optimization：既存環境の診断（Org診断 & ヘルスチェック）および最適化提案

You're Our Person If...

コミュニケーション能力経営層を含む顧客と適切な意思疎通を図り、合意形成を推進できること関連組織のメンバーに対し、敬意を払いつつ率直かつ建設的な対話ができること

専門的かつ幅広いスキルを習得し、市場価値の高いアーキテクトへ成長できます。

We encourage motivated individuals who love what they do, value a service first mindset and embrace a challenge to explore a career with Airservices. An Airservices leader leads inclusively
, thinks strategically
, collaborates
and communicates
with impact to deliver outcomes that support our culture of trust, care and accountability.

The manager will employ a prescriptive and tailored approach that focuses on standard work, integrated workflow automation and technology improvements. The manager will use data and analytics to drive and recommend new initiatives to Revenue Cycle leadership and inform department priorities. The Revenue Cycle Optimization Program Manager's project scope will span across the enterprise requiring collaboration with the School of Medicine Directors of Finance and Administration, SHC, Stanford Medicine-Partners, and Tri-Valley Hospital and Ambulatory Directors, IT, as well as various SHC Revenue Cycle Leadership. The incumbent reviews, assesses, and designs workflows, as well as makes system functionality recommendations for the entire revenue cycle. .
