new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Blockchain Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Senior Project/ Program Manager
Department:
Project & Program Management
Level:
Senior
Employment Type:
Full-time

About the company
The company is a leading blockchain infrastructure company building technology that connects blockchains with real-world data, traditional systems, and other blockchain networks. They support applications across decentralized finance, tokenized assets, interoperability, and other onchain use cases.

We are looking for an experienced Project / Program Manager
with 5+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in technology, software, fintech, blockchain, or a similarly fast-moving environment.

This role is suited to a delivery-focused programme professional who can operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to execution. You will work across engineering, product, business development, operations, commercial, and other functions to turn strategic objectives into well-defined programmes and measurable outcomes.

You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, manage complex dependencies, engage confidently with senior stakeholders, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and create the operating rhythm required to deliver programmes successfully.

The Role
As a Project / Program Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic and cross-functional initiatives.

You will operate as a central point of coordination across multiple teams, ensuring that programme objectives, priorities, dependencies, risks, resources, and timelines remain aligned.
The successful candidate will be comfortable working in an environment where requirements can evolve rapidly and where programmes may involve highly technical subject matter. You should be able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders without needing to be the technical subject-matter expert.

You will be expected to lead through influence rather than authority
, establish clarity in ambiguous situations, and ensure that teams remain focused on outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Programme Leadership
Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of complex, cross-functional programmes.
Translate strategic objectives into clear programme goals, roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and success measures.
Establish programme governance, operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and reporting structures.
Coordinate multiple interconnected projects and workstreams to ensure alignment against overall programme objectives.
Manage programme dependencies across engineering, product, operations, commercial, legal, finance, and other functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, sequence, or restructure initiatives to improve delivery outcomes.
Ensure programmes remain aligned with organisational priorities as requirements and circumstances evolve.

Delivery & Execution
Drive execution against agreed milestones, outcomes, budgets, and timelines.
Maintain appropriate programme plans, roadmaps, RAID logs, dependency maps, and decision registers.
Establish clear ownership and accountability across programme workstreams.
Identify delivery risks and issues early, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate appropriately.
Remove blockers by coordinating the appropriate stakeholders and decision-makers.
Monitor programme health and intervene when delivery is at risk.
Lead retrospectives and post-programme reviews to identify lessons learned and improve future delivery.
Establish and continuously improve project and programme management practices across the organisation.

Stakeholder Management
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and functional leaders.
Provide concise, transparent, and actionable programme reporting to leadership.
Facilitate difficult conversations around priorities, dependencies, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level and clearly communicated to affected teams.
Translate complex technical or operational information into clear business-level insights.
Align stakeholders with different objectives around common programme outcomes.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to programme sponsors and senior leadership.

Strategic Planning
Partner with leadership to define programme objectives, priorities, scope, and measures of success.
Support portfolio-level planning and prioritisation.
Identify cross-programme dependencies, resource constraints, and strategic risks.
Develop programme roadmaps that balance strategic ambition with realistic execution.
Use data, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to assess programme performance and inform decisions.
Help shape organisational processes and operating models as the company scales.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience
5+ years of professional experience in project management, programme management, product operations, consulting, technology delivery, or a related discipline.

Demonstrable experience leading complex, cross-functional programmes from initiation through delivery.
Experience working with engineering, product, technology, or other highly technical teams.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and dependencies simultaneously.
Experience operating with senior leadership and providing executive-level programme reporting.
Strong understanding of programme governance, risk management, dependency management, and delivery methodologies.
Demonstrable experience managing ambiguity and bringing structure to complex or evolving initiatives.
Demonstrable analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
Track record of influencing and driving outcomes without direct line-management authority.
Experience operating in a remote, distributed, and international organisation.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Desirable Experience

Experience within blockchain, Web3, fintech, financial services, SaaS, infrastructure, or emerging technology.
Experience working within Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery environments.
Experience with programme portfolio management.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, Asana, or equivalent platforms.
Formal project/programme management qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, AgilePM, Scrum, or equivalent is a plus
Working knowledge of blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, DeFi, tokenization, interoperability, or Web3.

Leadership & Working Style

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution
.
Creates clarity from ambiguity

You are comfortable entering situations where the objectives, ownership, requirements, or timelines are not yet fully defined. You bring structure, ask the right questions, establish accountability, and create a practical path forward.
Takes ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply managing tasks. You proactively identify risks, address issues, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
Leads through influence

You can bring together senior stakeholders, engineers, product leaders, and business teams around a common objective without relying on formal authority.
Communicates with precision

You know what different stakeholders need to know and can communicate complex information clearly, concisely, and appropriately for the audience.
Thinks strategically

You understand the relationship between individual projects and broader organisational objectives. You can move between detailed execution and high-level strategic thinking.
Challenges constructively

You are willing to challenge assumptions, question existing processes, and raise difficult issues when doing so improves the programme outcome.
Remains adaptable

The blockchain and technology landscape evolves rapidly. You can adjust plans when circumstances change while maintaining clarity around the underlying objectives.

Measures of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:
Successfully deliver complex programmes against agreed strategic objectives.
Establish clear accountability across multiple teams and workstreams.
Maintain strong programme visibility for senior leadership.
Identify and mitigate material risks before they become critical delivery issues.
Resolve complex cross-functional dependencies and unblock teams.
Improve predictability, transparency, and quality of programme delivery.
Build strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop scalable programme-management practices as the organisation grows.
Create measurable improvements in programme outcomes, operational efficiency, or organisational capability.
Become a trusted strategic delivery partner to senior leaders and programme sponsors.

What You Will Bring

You will bring the maturity to operate independently, the programme-management expertise to lead complex initiatives, and the curiosity to understand highly technical subject matter.
You don't need to be a blockchain engineer. You do need to be comfortable working alongside highly technical teams, asking intelligent questions, understanding dependencies and risks, and translating complex information into decisions and actions.
Most importantly, you will be someone who can connect strategy to execution
— turning ambitious objectives into clear plans, aligning teams around those plans, and driving delivery through to measurable outcomes.

Program Manager, Grateful Patient Philanthropy

Reporting to the Executive Director, Edward Foundation — with a dotted line report to the Manager, Prospect Development & Research— the Program Manager, Grateful Patient Philanthropy is responsible for managing the cross-functional daily operations of Endeavor Health’s Grateful Patient Program and partnering across the Philanthropy Team to expand and strengthen our pool of grateful patient and family donors. In partnership with Prospect Development & Research, Analytics, Annual Giving and gift officers, the Program Manager identifies and qualifies patients and families with philanthropic potential, manages initial grateful patient outreach and referral processes, and supports the timely movement of prospects into annual, mid-level and major gift pipelines. The position works closely with clinical partners and colleagues across Philanthropy to ensure a coordinated, consistent and high-quality donor experience in support of Endeavor Health’s North Star to build world-class care in communities we call home.

This role is crucial to Endeavor Health’s philanthropic growth strategy as we set our sights to deliver the highest quality primary and subspecialty care, advance innovative research, and invest in our people, all the while sustaining our deep commitment to our local communities. We are seeking someone who is relationship-focused, detail oriented, a strong communicator, and excellent writer with a background in project management, leading edge practices and a collaborative spirit who exemplifies Endeavor’s values of kindness, ownership, teamwork, and excellence.

Position Highlights

Position: Program Manager, Grateful Patient Philanthropy
Location: Warrenville, IL
Full Time/Part Time: Full Time
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm. May require occasional early mornings, nights and weekends.

Manage intake and assignment of grateful patients in consultation with the Prospect Development & Research team.

Program strategy and partnership

Collaborate with Philanthropy leadership to define and execute the overall program strategy, from utilization of the patient data feed through identification and qualification of major, planned, and principal gift prospects.
Partner with Annual Giving to develop and refine program materials, communications and acquisition strategies that build a growing pipeline of new donors and support their progression through the fundraising continuum.

Clinical Liaison

Reporting & analytics
Partner with Operations team to measure program performance and impact.
Monitor CRM activity, outreach and prospect movement, and provide regular reporting to Philanthropy leadership to ensure timely movement of prospects through the pipeline.

Other relevant duties as required, including supporting select early morning, evening or weekend donor stewardship and cultivation events; approximately quarterly throughout the year.

Ability to communicate professionally and build trust with diverse individuals.

Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and web-based meeting platforms (e.g., WebEx, Teams, Zoom).
Proficiency in donor/sales databases, preferably Salesforce, and sophisticated email platforms, preferably Salesforce Marketing Cloud

About The Role

The Technical Project Manager runs the launch of new hardware products at Doodle Labs, from kickoff to the day they ship. You'll keep Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Sales working off one plan. That means building the schedule, tracking dependencies, raising risks early, and making sure every team is ready when the product is.

This role reports to our Co-CEO and is based in Austin, TX. You'll work closely with product and engineering leadership to turn priorities into launch plans that hold up in the real world.

It's a great fit if you've been in the middle of a hardware launch before, you know where they tend to slip, and you like getting a lot of different teams to land something together.

Own the launch plan for new hardware products, from kickoff through production release and customer availability
Build and manage one integrated schedule across Engineering (hardware, RF, firmware, and software), Operations, Marketing, and Sales
Run the launch rhythm: team check-ins, milestone and phase-gate reviews, and clear written status updates for leadership
Track dependencies, risks, and open issues, and push them to resolution before they hit the schedule
Work with Operations and our manufacturing partners on the move from prototype to production, including builds, testing, certification, and supply readiness
Partner with Marketing and Sales on launch readiness: timing, collateral, sales training, and customer communication
Help keep product requirements and release documentation organized and current, so every team is working from the same version
Track releases and keep a clear record of what shipped, what changed, and what's coming next
Lead launch retros and keep improving how we bring products to market

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You know our product lines, how they get built, and the people behind them. You've put a working launch plan and team rhythm in place for the next hardware launch.
First 6 months: Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Sales are working from one schedule. Risks come up early, and leadership has a clear weekly view of where the launch stands.
First 12 months: You've taken a new hardware product through launch on a plan the team trusted, and we have a repeatable launch process we can use for the next one.

Who You Are

5+ years of project or program management experience
Hands-on experience launching a new hardware product as the project or program manager. You've owned the plan and coordinated Engineering, Marketing, and Operations through launch.
A working understanding of how hardware gets built: prototype builds, EVT/DVT/PVT, the hand-off to manufacturing, and supply chain lead times
Comfortable working between technical and commercial teams. You can follow an engineering conversation, turn it into a plan, and explain it in terms Sales and Marketing can use.
Strong organizer and communicator: clear written updates, well-run meetings, and follow-through people can count on
Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments where the plan changes and you adjust with it

Preferred Qualifications

Launch experience with a wireless or RF product (radios, networking gear, IoT devices, or similar), including regulatory certification like FCC or CE
Experience in drones, robotics, autonomy, or wireless networking
Experience working with OEMs, contract manufacturers, or embedded systems
Experience working with teams across time zones
Familiarity with defense or dual-use markets (not required)

Work on cutting-edge technology powering the future of autonomous systems
See the products you help launch go out into the field and get used by people who depend on them
Collaborate with engineers and innovators building industry-leading connectivity solutions
Make a meaningful impact in a fast-growing company shaping the next generation of robotics and wireless networking

Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus One Medical, Teladoc, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Kindbody, and sponsored gym memberships

Purpose of the Role

The Senior Project Manager governs selected major new-business projects and strategic investments end to end, driving quote-to-cash conversion, lead-time and ROI performance across the full lifecycle – from opportunity and quotation through business-case approval, nomination and investment release to launch, ramp-up and value realization.
As the central project governance lead within the Hong Kong Account Management team, the role validates key commercial, financial and operational assumptions early, keeps customer commitments, costs, capacity, CAPEX and incremental OpEx aligned with the approved business case, and provides management with clear decision-ready visibility. The role carries governance, challenge and escalation authority; formal commercial, financial and operational approvals remain with the respective functions.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Governance and Stage-Gate Leadership

Own the end-to-end governance and value-creation tracking of selected major new-business projects and strategic investments, including significant new facilities, capacity expansion, major equipment and infrastructure.
Engage early in major opportunities to validate critical assumptions, including expected volume, revenue, gross margin, production location, capacity, equipment, materials, systems, resources, timeline and investment requirements.
Establish and facilitate structured Stage-Gate Reviews at three critical management gates: (1) Quotation & Business-Case Approval, (2) Nomination & Investment Release, and (3) Post-Launch Value Realization.
Challenge material gaps or deviations and recommend go / conditional-go / hold / re-plan / recover / escalate decisions, escalating unresolved cross-functional issues, major delays or material business-case deviations to senior management.
Maintain a transparent risk, action and decision log with clearly identified owners, target dates, decisions and escalation status.

Business-Case and Investment Management

Ensure the business case captures full project economics, including CAPEX, incremental OpEx, start-up and development costs, sampling and testing costs, exceptional logistics, advance material commitments, working-capital requirements, cash generation, ROI and payback.
Revalidate the approved business case following customer nomination and before significant investment release, particularly where volume, product, material, location, timing or resource assumptions have changed.
Track project scope, milestones, investment timing, operational readiness and actual performance against the approved baseline.

Value Realization and Performance Improvement

Monitor actual orders, sales volume, capacity utilization, gross margin, project costs and investment returns against the approved business case, continuing post-launch monitoring through stabilization until the expected commercial and financial outcomes are sustainably achieved.
Drive improvement in quote-to-cash conversion and project lead time, identifying bottlenecks, resource constraints and cross-functional gaps.
Drive corrective actions where actual performance falls below plan, including value engineering, procurement leverage, process improvement, automation, capacity optimization and commercial recovery.

Success Criteria:

Improvement in quote-to-cash conversion and project lead time.
Achievement of critical business-case, nomination, investment, launch and stabilization milestones.
CAPEX, incremental OpEx and total project costs delivered against the approved business case.
Actual sales volume, capacity utilization and gross margin delivered in line with approved assumptions.
ROI, payback and business-value realization against approved targets.
Timely revalidation of the business case following material changes.
Timely closure or escalation of critical risks and cross-functional actions.
Quantifiable value improvement through value engineering, procurement, process improvement, automation and recovery initiatives.

What We Are Looking For:

At least 10 years of project management experience in a manufacturing, industrial or B2B environment, ideally in labels, trims, packaging, apparel or related manufacturing.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with understand, evaluate, challenge and revalidate business cases covering CAPEX, incremental OpEx, working capital, ROI and payback.
A track record of delivering measurable improvement in quote-to-cash conversion, project lead time or comparable commercial-performance metrics.
Experience coordinating commercial, finance, operations, manufacturing, supply chain and quality functions, with the ability to lead effectively in a matrix organization and influence senior stakeholders across regions.
Strong analytical, governance and reporting skills, giving management clear visibility of project status, business-case variance, risks and required decisions.
Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and escalate where required.

The role also serves as the governance lead for all cybersecurity matters across the organization, partnering closely with Infrastructure, Engineering, QA, Product, Legal, and Corporate Technology teams. The ideal candidate is both a technical security expert and a business-minded collaborator, capable of balancing security requirements with operational efficiency and business objectives.

Manage email security and phishing defense, including phishing investigation and triage, security awareness training, and phishing simulation programs.
Lead security incident investigations and response efforts, coordinating remediation and root-cause analysis activities.

Web and Digital Platform Security

Manage cloud network architecture and security controls for Forbes' consumer-facing digital platforms.
Oversee source code and development platform security, including repository access controls, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline security.
Own the vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management program across web properties and infrastructure, driving remediation with Engineering.

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
CISSP, CCSP, CISM, Security+ and/or GIAC certifications preferred.
7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including cloud security, infrastructure security, network security, or security engineering.

Experience managing enterprise productivity suites, identity and access management platforms, public cloud platforms, and endpoint protection and threat detection solutions.
Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, network infrastructure, and cloud networking across multiple cloud providers.
Practical experience applying AI tools to security and engineering workflows, such as automation, detection, triage, and reporting, and familiarity with governing safe AI adoption across an enterprise.
Strong scripting and automation skills for security workflow and identity lifecycle automation.
Experience supporting PCI audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
Deep understanding of identity management, privileged access controls, authentication, and authorization principles.
Skilled in leading investigations, incident response, vulnerability management, and threat analysis.
Experience developing and maintaining security policies, standards, and governance processes.
Experience partnering with legal and procurement teams on vendor security reviews and contract preparation.
Proven ability to balance strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical execution.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The position coordinates multidisciplinary engineering teams, suppliers, program controls, manufacturing, quality, security, and customers; maintains disciplined plans and records; and resolves execution obstacles before they threaten delivery.

Coordinate project resource requirements, including labor, equipment, materials, and technical support, in collaboration with functional managers and project leadership.

Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

We are hiring for two Manager roles with a different emphasis.

One leans towards strategy and qualitative insight, such as spotting the macro trends shaping consumer behaviour and competition.

The other leans towards quantitative and analytical work, such as building a trusted view of market dynamics across our markets.

Both help build a faster, higher-quality Competitive & Market Intelligence (CMI) engine, and we will talk through which suits you best during the interview process. We are looking for someone who lives our behaviours of lead, deliver and care, puts our customers first and works as part of a team to get things done.

Either role can be located in Amsterdam or London.

These are some of the key components to the position:

Partner with the business - act as the Competitive Intelligence partner to country and functional leads, turning local signals into strategic insight for leadership.
Build one source of truth - create consistency across markets and a single, trusted view of market and competitive dynamics.
Spot what's next - identify the macro trends in consumer behaviour, category dynamics and competition that should shape JET's long-term strategy.
Make it actionable - translate insight into clear, concise recommendations for senior leadership.
Go deep - support the Head of Competitive Intelligence on deep-dive analyses of major competitor moves, market events and strategic questions.
Build our sources - build and maintain CMI's own qualitative sources (e.g. an expert network) to raise the speed and quality of our insight.
Automate and scale - partner with our central Data & Analytics (DNA) team on quantitative data platforms, building automation and AI tools.

What will you bring to the team?

Experience in competitive intelligence, corporate strategy or strategy consulting.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn fragmented signals and local market data into a clear, consistent, forward-looking picture.
Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative sources, with a particular strength in one and an appetite to grow in the other.
Executive presence, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and a talent for concise, compelling narratives.
A partnering mindset, building trusted relationships with country, functional and senior leaders based on respect and mutual support.
Independent, proactive and intellectually curious, following where the details and data lead.
A collaborative approach to working across a global, matrixed organisation.
Curiosity about data, automation and AI tools, and how they can raise the bar for the speed and quality of insight.

At JET, this is how we play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

What else are we delivering?

As a Strategic Operations Analyst, you will play an important role in optimizing product performance and operational excellence across a growing global travel business. Working at the intersection of Product and Operations, you will help ensure that product launches deliver outstanding customer experiences while meeting business and operational objectives. You will analyze performance data, customer feedback, and experiment results to identify opportunities for improvement and support informed decision-making. Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Operations leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will turn complex insights into actionable recommendations. You will contribute to defining operational requirements, improving service standards, and building scalable processes that support sustainable growth. This role offers an exciting opportunity to develop product expertise, take ownership of strategic initiatives, and make a measurable impact within a fast-paced, remote-first technology environment.

Accountabilities

Support the Strategic Operations Manager in overseeing the operational aspects of the product launch lifecycle across the Travel business, including flights, experiences, and global hotel services.
Represent the customer perspective in product discussions by bringing customer feedback, support contact trends, and agent insights into decision-making processes.
Coordinate operational launch activities, including requirements gathering, readiness assessments, stakeholder alignment, implementation planning, and post-launch performance evaluations.
Assess product launches and operational changes by analyzing experiment results, A/B tests, customer interactions, and support performance to determine their effectiveness.
Identify performance gaps, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, developing evidence-based recommendations for Product Managers and senior stakeholders.
Monitor short-term and long-term operational performance against customer experience KPIs, service-level agreements, and business objectives.
Evaluate opportunities to improve service quality and cost efficiency while ensuring that customer experience standards remain consistently high.
Develop, maintain, and optimize operational dashboards that provide real-time and historical visibility into key performance indicators.
Translate data findings into actionable business proposals, presenting insights and recommendations to Product, Operations leadership, and other relevant stakeholders.
Create and maintain standardized operational procedures, documentation, and launch playbooks to improve consistency, scalability, and execution.
Collaborate with Customer Operations teams and product stakeholders to ensure operational execution aligns with product requirements and performance expectations.
Investigate operational trends, inconsistencies, and customer experience issues, taking ownership of improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Build a strong understanding of business and customer needs, progressively developing the expertise required to own a specific product area.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
Between 2 and 5 years of professional experience in product management, strategic operations, business operations, or a fast-growing startup environment.
Previous exposure to product development and launch processes, including familiarity with Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), operational readiness, and product implementation.
Experience measuring and evaluating experiments, A/B tests, or product performance initiatives and presenting findings to product-oriented stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to transform data into meaningful insights, practical recommendations, and measurable business improvements.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Claude to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and automate repetitive tasks.
Strong investigative and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to identify inconsistencies, uncover root causes, and proactively recognize improvement opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills, combined with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Familiarity with Excel, SQL, and data visualization platforms is considered an advantage.
Experience designing AI-powered workflows or automations that have been adopted and used by other team members is a plus.
Knowledge of customer service operations, support processes, and service quality standards is desirable.
A proactive, adaptable, and results-oriented mindset, with a genuine interest in product thinking, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative, remote-first team.

Benefits

Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from USD 68,000 to USD 101,000, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.
Additional compensation: Equity options and annual performance-based bonus opportunities.
Retirement benefits: Employer retirement contribution matching.
Comprehensive healthcare: Access to competitive employee benefits and healthcare coverage.
Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with the freedom to choose working hours that best support your productivity and lifestyle.
Unlimited paid time off: Flexible vacation policy that encourages employees to take time to rest and recharge.
Company recharge days: Additional company-wide days dedicated to rest and well-being.
Team offsites: Annual team gatherings that encourage collaboration, connection, and relationship-building.
Everyday perks: Weekly Uber Eats credits and exclusive travel discounts through the company's travel platform.
Family support: Generous parental leave and a flexible return-to-work program for growing families.
Wellness benefits: Access to dedicated wellness budgets to support personal health and well-being.
Professional development: Personal development funds and team-level learning resources to support continuous growth.
Career progression: Opportunities to develop product expertise, expand responsibilities, and progressively take ownership of strategic product areas.
Innovative environment: Work with modern technologies and AI-powered tools in a fast-paced, high-growth technology organization.
Inclusive workplace: Join a collaborative environment that values employee development, diverse perspectives, flexibility, and equal opportunities.

Under the general direction of the Security Risk Management Lead, be part of a team that partners with stakeholders across Manitoba Hydro to manage cyber security risk. The position will support security programs, conduct security risk assessments and provide security guidance to project teams.

Responsibilities

Conduct security risk assessments on applications to prevent vulnerabilities and entry points that attackers can exploit.
Contribute to security risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies to resolve vulnerabilities and recommend and support security changes to system or system components as needed.
Conduct cyber security risk assessments of third-party suppliers and service providers and support the ongoing monitoring of supplier security risk throughout the contract lifecycle.
Support the alignment of cyber security risks with Manitoba Hydro's enterprise risk management framework, including rolling up assessment findings into enterprise-level cyber risk reporting.
Participate on project teams to provide security guidance and ensure security controls and requirements are ‘baked in' and addressed during the project.
Assist with the third-party Enterprise Technology Security Assessment and manage the resulting recommendations and action plans.
Direct activities of external suppliers and support establishing and overseeing monitoring, selection and termination of suppliers.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of risk management methods, templates, intake processes and supporting documentation.
Develop and maintain good working relationships with industry contacts for the purpose of information exchange and to keep abreast of technology innovation and directions. Develop and maintain good working relationships with contacts within D&T, ICS teams, and stakeholders throughout Manitoba Hydro including subsidiaries.

Qualifications

A four-year degree in Computer Science or related discipline from a university of recognized standing plus a minimum of three years related information technology (IT) or industrial control system (ICS) Support experience of which at least one year must be in a system support role;
OR
A two-year diploma in Electrical, Electronic, or Computer Technology from an institute of recognized standing plus a minimum of five years related IT or ICS Support experience of which at least three years must be in a system support role.
Entry level cyber security certification(s) with organizations such as ISACA or ISC 2 would be an asset.
General understanding of technology and how it is deployed to support the Enterprise including information technology (IT), operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems (ICS).
Knowledge of ICS Cyber Security Risk Management and NERC Critical Information Protection (CIP) Standards, Programs and Procedures, CIP infrastructure components and CIP cyber assets.
Strong oral and written communication skills and able to communicate effectively to all levels of management and staff. Demonstrated ability to build good working relationships and work effectively in team environments.
Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated creativity in resolving information technology issues, implementing new processes and products and redesigning work processes. Demonstrated focus on documentation and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated initiative, and ability to prioritize, and achieve results in a timely manner.
Possess strong analytical skills, be self-motivating, and possess mature judgment with the ability to make and implement sound decisions.
Obtain and maintain a current Personnel Risk Assessment and a "Clear" security rating in accordance with Manitoba Hydro policy P513.
NERC CIP Training is required, must be completed prior to transfer date, and renewed annually.

Salary Range

Starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The range for the classification is $40.44-$55.99 Hourly, $77,500.02-$107,279.64 Annually.

new_jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific. Our competitive moat is our data: the deepest, most localised company and people dataset in every market we operate in. We've proven the model in ANZ. Now we're scaling it across Southeast Asia and the US.

US reps can only sell as fast as the systems behind them. This role builds and runs the engine that turns their activity into clean, trusted pipeline.

The role

The GTM Operations Analyst
owns the tooling, data and processes our US sales team relies on every day, so pipeline is built, tracked and measured properly from day one.

This is not a ticket-taking admin role. You'll own Nooks end to end, shape account allocation, build the reporting US leadership runs on, and work with GTM Engineering to automate away rep busywork.

Reporting to the Head of Growth (Melbourne), with a strong dotted line to the VP Americas. Based in San Francisco.

About 75% hands-on execution:
tool admin, HubSpot, campaigns, reporting and rep support. About 25% process improvement:
fixing friction and rolling out new tooling.

What you'll own

US sales tooling: own and administer Nooks (configuration, users, integrations, adoption), evaluate new tools and train reps so they stick
Campaigns: build, launch and measure outbound and multi-channel US campaigns with GTM Engineering
Account allocation: keep territory and ownership rules clear, balanced and enforced in our systems
HubSpot administration: support global RevOps on properties, workflows, pipelines, reporting and users for the US team
Data integrity: keep data accurate across systems so pipeline, attribution and performance tracking can be trusted
Reporting: build the dashboards that give the VP Americas and Head of Growth a clear view of US pipeline, activity and conversion
Enablement: Notion documentation, playbooks and process fixes that remove manual work for reps
Global alignment: be the link between the US team and Australia, and support rep onboarding and lifecycle tracking

What we're looking for

Must haves

RevOps experience: around 2 years in RevOps, sales ops or GTM ops, ideally supporting an outbound team at a B2B SaaS company
Hands-on HubSpot: you've built properties, workflows, lists, pipelines and reports, not just used them
Sales engagement tool ownership: you've administered Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Lemlist or similar
Data quality instinct: you notice when numbers don't add up and fix the process, not just the record
Clear communicator: you translate between sales, marketing and technical teams, and write docs reps actually use
Self-directed across time zones: you prioritise well when the US and global teams both need you
You live and breathe AI tools. You use AI for analysis, automation, documentation and troubleshooting by default. In 2026, this is how one GTM Ops Analyst supports an entire US sales team, and you need to already be doing it.

Highly valued

HubSpot certifications
Automation tooling: n8n, Zapier or similar
Startup or scaleup background where you've had to build the standard, not inherit it

The environment

Firmable runs lean and ships fast: small senior teams, no layers, minimal process. You'll sit in San Francisco with the US sales team, working closely with Growth, GTM Engineering and RevOps in Melbourne.

We are an AI-native organisation
: AI is our default operating mode, from pipeline and data-quality analysis to automated rep workflows and agentic campaign research. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why this role

Build the US engine from the ground up: shape the systems the US sales team runs on
Real ownership: own US tooling with a direct line to the Head of Growth and VP Americas
Real career runway: grow into RevOps lead, GTM systems or US operations leadership; the ceiling is set by output, not tenure

This role probably isn't for you if

You want a ticket queue and a clear spec for every request
Fixing the record feels like enough, even when the process that broke it is still running
Reps feel like end users to manage rather than customers to serve
You do your best work inside an established RevOps function with documented systems
A manager in another time zone and a lot of autonomy sounds more stressful than exciting
AI is still on your "to learn" list rather than part of how you work every day

Job Overview

We are seeking a Market Research Analyst with strong metadata and taxonomy skills to support a strategic knowledge management initiative focused on improving the discoverability, governance, and AI readiness of a large enterprise insights repository. This Market Research Analyst will review a library of 1,500+ market research and insights reports in Stravito and determine, based on the content, what each study is: the research type, methodology, audience, and business question it answered. They will then assess whether the current metadata and taxonomy describe those studies accurately, recommend targeted improvements, and apply them, supporting future AI-powered search, retrieval, and knowledge discovery. This is a highly hands-on role that starts with marketing research expertise. The ideal candidate can open an unfamiliar report and, without consulting others, recognize whether it is a segmentation study, social listening analysis, in-depth interview (IDI) project, brand tracker, concept test, or something else. They pair that judgment with strong metadata, content auditing, and taxonomy skills to review the current catalogue, identify errors or inconsistencies, and help fix them.

Research Classification & Methodology Recognition Responsibilities

Read and interpret 1,500+ research reports independently and identify the type of research and methodology in each (for example, segmentation, social listening, in-depth interviews (IDIs), focus groups, brand health tracking, concept or ad testing, conjoint or pricing research, ethnography, customer experience or voice-of-customer, competitive intelligence, syndicated or secondary research).
Distinguish quantitative from qualitative work, primary from secondary research, and custom from syndicated studies, using the report content (methodology sections, sample descriptions, questionnaires, and findings) rather than relying on titles or existing tags.
Capture the marketing context of each study: the business question, target audience or segment, product or brand, geography, time period, and how the findings were meant to be used.
Spot reports that were mislabeled, vaguely described, or tagged in a way that hides what the research actually is, and correct or flag them.
Build a clear reference of research types and methodologies, with plain-language definitions and examples, that the tagging approach and AI-generated tags can be checked against.
Use marketing judgment to assess the relevance, recency, and rigor of studies, informing future content quality and confidence indicators.

About The Role

Collabera is seeking a Business Analyst for a 12+ month contract supporting Corporate Investment Banking Operations in Charlotte, North Carolina. This is a hybrid position with a Monday-to-Friday schedule, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The successful candidate will work on the post-trade side of digital asset trading as the team advances into system integration testing. You will help translate business needs into clear requirements, review trade files, identify required changes, coordinate dependencies, and track testing progress and outcomes.

This role is suited to an experienced analyst who can collaborate across business and technology teams, organize detailed information, and communicate findings clearly. The Product Owner is responsible for creating Jira stories; this position focuses on analysis, coordination, file review, testing preparation, and reporting. The hourly compensation range is $70 to $73. The range reflects base compensation and may vary according to location, market conditions, experience, and candidate qualifications.

Qualifications

Candidates should have at least six years of Business Analyst experience, including demonstrated ability to capture information, elicit and document requirements, and support user acceptance testing. Experience in digital assets is required. Relevant areas may include cryptocurrency such as Bitcoin or Ethereum, distributed ledger technology, blockchain, digital asset custody, settlement, or related trading operations. An understanding of post-trade processes and the ability to review and interpret trade files will be valuable.

Applicants should be comfortable querying information with SQL and organizing or analyzing data using Excel. Experience preparing presentations or communicating results in PowerPoint is useful; familiarity with Copilot or similar productivity tools may also support reporting workflows. Strong attention to detail, clear written and verbal communication, sound organization, and the ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders are important. Candidates should be able to track dependencies, manage testing documentation, and report results accurately in a fast-moving banking environment.

Responsibilities

Gather, clarify, and document business and operational requirements for digital asset post-trade processes. Review trade files and related information to understand current workflows, identify issues, and determine what changes may be needed. Coordinate with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to track dependencies, resolve open questions, and maintain visibility into testing activities.

Support system integration testing and user acceptance testing by developing and maintaining test plans and test scripts, preparing test information, executing or coordinating test scenarios, and recording results. Track defects, exceptions, and follow-up actions, and communicate testing status and outcomes to relevant stakeholders. Use SQL to query data when needed, and use Excel, PowerPoint, and/or Copilot to organize files, analyze information, and prepare clear reports. Help ensure that requirements and testing outcomes are understood and that work remains aligned with operational needs.

Compensation is $70 to $73 per hour, subject to applicable terms and candidate qualifications. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; and paid parking or public transportation support. Depending on eligibility and applicable policies, paid time off, paid sick and safe time, vacation, parental leave, and paid holidays may also be available. Benefit offerings and eligibility are governed by the applicable plan terms.

Equal Opportunity

Collabera is committed to fair and equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination and in accordance with applicable laws. Experience supporting a Department of Defense, U.S. Navy, NAVAIR, or comparable program office

Experience preparing program reports, briefings, meeting materials, schedules, milestone trackers, or action-item logs
Intermediate Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, including organizing and analyzing data and developing clear presentations

This entry to mid-level Technical Analyst position is targeted specifically to contractors with 8 or more years of relevant information technology experience to support Digital team in developing industry leading web, mobile, chat and voice solutions to meet our Members’ evolving financial needs. The role involves collaboration with business analysts, solution architects, developers, and testers to assess needs and define the technical system requirements for solutions.

Job Description:

Assume leadership of collaboration with product ownership to translate business need into the technical system requirements of the product
Proactively identify requirement gaps and issue to product ownership
Ensure non-happy path scenarios are considered and handled
Advocate for solutions that consider ease of maintenance and component reuse opportunities
Leverage available documentation and exercises test versions of applications and APIs to understand existing functionality to inform enhancement opportunities and creation of new capabilities
Investigate enterprise and vendor APIs to determine whether necessary data is available to support intended system capabilities
Map data between interfacing systems
Assist lead analysts in developing and prioritizing features and epics to ensure work focuses on requirements with maximum value and are aligned with product delivery strategy
Participate in project planning, sprint and release planning, daily stand-up meetings (scrums), demos/reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement meetings, and other Scrum-related meetings.
Perform application and services tests/validations
Responsible for creating system requirement documentation for applications and services, including interface specifications
Provide demos to internal project team, as well as to business stakeholders.
Works closely with Business, Quality Assurance team and developers on projects and to address production issues
Demonstrate ability to excel in a fast-paced environment with aggressive timelines that require managing multiple priorities concurrently
Utilize system documentation, database information, application logs and scenario testing to determine root cause of system issues.

Have general understanding or working knowledge of the following:

Services-oriented architecture / microservices
Multi-tier applications (presentation tier/services-processing tier/data management tier)
Enterprise and vendor API integration
Managing system behavior through configurable variables
Error handling
XML and JSON data structures

Qualifications/Experience:

Ability to write SQL queries
Problem solving skill – Works well under pressure and challenges, team-player, good listener, analytical, creative, approachable, etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to partner with various levels of leadership within the organization
Conducting complex technical analysis across multiple products
Work in Agile methodology
Writing requirements for a system
Writing front end mobile and/or web application requirements is a plus
Writing back end service requirements is a plus
Experience using tools such as Postman or SoapUI to exercise APIs is a plus

Digital Technical Analysis Contractor Role Clarifications 2026-11-13

Front-End Analysis Experience
Analysts must do more than describe front-end behavior, such as display and navigation results from user actions. They must also define the technical orchestration those actions trigger: service calls (specific endpoints), error and partial-success handling, dynamic content, analytics tagging, and conditional display.
Back-End Analysis Experience
Analysts must do more than test and validate API requests and responses in a tool such as Postman. They must also define the requirements for service behavior: data retrieval, interactions with other services, business logic and rules, data transformations, response object mapping, and logging or events generated from the outcome.
Analysts should be able to independently research enterprise and vendor APIs to find data sources for new functionality, or to document the changes existing APIs need to support it.
Architectural Understanding
Analysts should understand the differences between the presentation tier, middle service tier, and data tier, and how best to distribute functionality across them, especially in a multi-channel application.
Not required, but helpful: If analysts know the difference between native mobile apps and responsive websites that adapt to mobile screens.
Analysts should have an intuitive sense of when to check whether existing reusable components could be used, so new functionality isn't built redundantly.
Documentation
Technical User Stories: Analysts should be able to understand and write Gherkin acceptance criteria that include technical details, such as service behavior and endpoints and any other relevant technical details.
Living Technical Specifications: Analysts should be able to maintain documentation for each capability and update it continuously as functionality changes.
Collaborative Knowledge Management: Analysts should have experience documenting in a wiki format with a tool such as Azure DevOps or Confluence.

+ Must Have's:

Experience capturing technical requirements for information systems/applications

Experience working with APIs

Familiarity with multi-tier applications (application layer, services layer, data layer)

+ Nice to Have's:

Experience using tools such as Postman or SoapUI to exercise APIs

Experience in the financial industry

Experience working on requirements for native mobile applications

new_jobs.title: All-Source Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0253811

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our defense policymakers.

As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission and operational landscape. You’ll validate information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for DoD customers. This is a chance to grow your expertise and develop new skills in strategic all-source regional analysis to inform DoD customers and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation's leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

2+ years of experience with research and analysis
Experience with the CENTCOM or AFRICOM AOR
Experience with ICD 203 tradecraft standards
Knowledge of the DoD, wider IC, and Combatant Command environments
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
HS diploma or GED and 6+ years of experience with all-source analysis, Associate's degree and 4+ years of experience with all-source analysis, or Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience with all-source analysis

Nice If You Have:

4+ years of experience as a strategic all-source intelligence analyst
Experience with data analytics, analysis, and visualization
Experience with C4I analysis and C4I tools such as MIDB and MARS
Knowledge of the intelligence cycle
Ability to display a willingness to learn
Possession of excellent interpersonal skills
Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including briefing

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

A strong analytical mindset and curiosity for understanding how things work

new_jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

Varda is seeking a Program Operations Manager
to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for all program reporting for cost and schedule. The scope spans Varda's operations as the company scales toward 12+ vehicles per year. You will own scheduling through the entire program life cycle, from baseline development through execution, change management, and closeout. You will work cross-functionally with Vehicle Systems, Integration and Test, Supply Chain, Production, Finance, and Mission Assurance to turn scope into executable plans.

This is a newly consolidated function. Beyond running the schedule, you will stand up the program controls reporting that replaces status collected by email. You will define the metrics the company manages to, and set the structure that lets cost and schedule tie together as Varda's contracting model matures. You will also set the standards the scheduling team works to, and direct the application engineers and data engineer who build the systems behind your reporting. Projects will include a wide range of desired outcomes, including cycle time reduction, improved decision-making, risk reduction, data quality, and defensible, audit-ready schedules.

This role will report to the Director of Enterprise Applications, with a dotted line to Program Management. Two contractor schedulers will report to you.

Responsibilities

Own the integrated master schedule (IMS) across all Varda operations, including critical path, near-critical activities, and key schedule drivers.
Run the weekly schedule cadence of status collection, forecast adjustment, and publish, communicating risks, impacts, and recovery options.
Set the DCMA-based health standard a schedule passes before it publishes, keeping schedules defensible and audit-ready.
Own baselines, re-baselining, engineering change cut-ins, and the impact analysis on schedules and operations.
Own the integration architecture across IMS, MRP, PLM, and ERP.
Define the program and scheduling requirements that drive MRP and ERP selection, configuration, and implementation.
Lead the program side of an MRP replacement, from vendor evaluation through data migration, validation, and cutover.
Own the scheduling toolset roadmap and partner with Application Engineers on build priorities.
Coordinate need dates and planning parameters with Supply Chain to initiate risk mitigations like long lead orders.
Co-develop with finance the work breakdown structure and control account coding to support government contracting.
Assist the VP, W-Series Vehicles and Finance with monthly earned value metrics, including mission-related spend and non-recurring and recurring engineering labor
Build the KPI and dashboard suite that replaces status collected by email, and own the metric definitions and thresholds behind it.
Set the standard for identifying and dispositioning the data quality issues that distort metrics.
Own programmatic risk and its tracking, with Mission Assurance owning technical risk.
Manage and grow the scheduling team, setting shared scheduling standards and the staffing plan as the function scales.

Basic Qualifications

B.S. or M.S. with emphasis in Project Management or related field.
8+ years of experience in mission, space vehicle, or production scheduling.
Expertise in schedule management tools, including MS Project and Smartsheet.
Direct experience integrating a scheduling tool with an MRP or ERP system (SAP, Costpoint, Oracle, ION).
Proficiency building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Smartsheet, or equivalent business intelligence tooling.
Experience leading schedulers, planners, or contractors.
Experience replacing manual status reporting with systems generated KPIs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross functional environment.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience in a fast paced aerospace or technology startup environment.
Background in space or aviation hardware production.
Familiarity with streamlined earned value management methods and tools.
Experience standing up a scheduling or program management function from scratch.
Experience building program controls structures that support cost-plus or government contract reporting requirements.

You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

Job Title: Fleet Data & Operations Analyst
Job Description

The Fleet Data & Operations Analyst supports sales forecasting, business analysis, financial reporting, incentive administration, and executive reporting for fleet operations. This early-career analytical role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying trends, solving problems, and transforming information into clear business insights. The position primarily supports fleet analytics and planning, and includes cross-training to provide backup support for critical vehicle ordering and tracking activities.

Responsibilities

Support monthly sales and production forecasting by analyzing key business data.
Analyze customer demand, sales, inventory, and production trends to inform decision-making.
Compare actual performance to forecasts and customer commitments, highlighting variances.
Identify trends, exceptions, and potential business risks and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses for fleet leadership and management.
Support customer and vehicle profitability analysis to optimize incentive strategies.
Prepare incentive calculations and supporting documentation with a high level of accuracy.
Validate incentive payment data, identify discrepancies, and work to resolve issues.
Assist with incentive reconciliation and approval processes to ensure timely payments.
Support monthly financial and business performance reporting across fleet operations.
Prepare and maintain Excel-based reports and management dashboards for key stakeholders.
Support existing Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, and other reporting tools.
Consolidate data from internal systems, vendors, and other sources into usable formats.
Validate data quality and resolve reporting discrepancies to maintain data integrity.
Identify opportunities to simplify, streamline, or automate recurring reports and dashboards.
Provide backup support for vehicle order placement and allocation during peak periods and critical deadlines.
Assist with production coordination to ensure orders are aligned with manufacturing schedules.
Support VIN and vehicle status tracking to keep stakeholders informed of order progress.
Participate in order reconciliation activities to ensure accuracy between systems and records.
Prepare customer and management status reporting related to order lifecycle activities.
Balance analytics and reporting responsibilities with order lifecycle backup support, which is expected to represent approximately 15 to 20 percent of the role.

Essential Skills

Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
1 to 3 years of experience in analytics, finance, operations, reporting, supply chain, or a related function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work with large datasets and identify trends, patterns, or inconsistencies.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical and technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, or similar reporting tools.
Experience with Power Query or other data transformation tools.
Exposure to forecasting, financial analysis, or operational reporting.
Experience creating dashboards or recurring management reports.

Recent graduates with relevant internship, academic, or project experience will be considered.
Automotive or fleet industry experience is helpful but not required.
Experience in data entry and data analysis within a business environment.
Background in analytics forecasting and reporting dashboards.
Ability to support order lifecycle processes, including vehicle ordering, tracking, and reconciliation.
Interest in developing deeper experience with Power BI, SAP Business Intelligence, forecasting, financial analysis, and automotive operations.

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DTP & E-learning Project Manager based in France.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on DTP & E-learning Project Manager to oversee multilingual desktop publishing and e-learning localization projects in an international environment. In this role, you will manage the entire production lifecycle, from initial file preparation and cost estimation to resource coordination, production, linguistic validation, and final quality assurance. You will take ownership of delivery standards, ensuring localized content is accurate, visually consistent, and ready for client use. Combining strong technical expertise with project management capabilities, you will work directly with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and clients to ensure smooth project execution. You will also troubleshoot complex formatting and localization challenges, providing practical solutions while maintaining quality and deadlines. This is a six-month, fully remote opportunity suited to a proactive professional who enjoys combining technical production work with project coordination and client-facing responsibilities.

Accountabilities

Manage the complete DTP and e-learning localization workflow, including pre-flight checks, file preparation, quotation, resource allocation, production, linguistic sign-off, and final delivery.
Assess incoming files and prepare them for translation and localization, identifying potential technical or formatting issues before production begins.
Estimate project costs, resource requirements, and production timelines based on file complexity, language combinations, and script requirements.
Coordinate and delegate DTP and e-learning production tasks to internal teams and external vendors, providing clear instructions, deadlines, and quality expectations.
Oversee multilingual DTP production, ensuring accurate formatting, layout consistency, font compatibility, and appropriate handling of text expansion across different languages and writing systems.
Work hands-on with source files to troubleshoot and resolve complex formatting, layout, and technical issues whenever necessary.
Manage e-learning localization projects, ensuring that localized training materials function correctly and maintain their intended structure and user experience.
Conduct quality assurance checks throughout the production process, including linguistic validation, document formatting, and final file verification.
Advise internal stakeholders on localization best practices, file preparation requirements, and efficient production workflows.
Act as a subject-matter expert in DTP and e-learning localization, participating in client discussions and providing technical recommendations when required.
Monitor project progress, proactively identify delivery risks, and implement solutions to maintain deadlines and quality standards.
Provide constructive feedback to vendors and production teams to continuously improve delivery quality and operational efficiency.

Requirements

At least 4 years of professional experience in multilingual DTP and e-learning production within the localization industry.
A demonstrable portfolio showcasing experience delivering multilingual files for real clients and managing the associated production workflows.
At least 2 years of experience scoping, estimating, quoting, and coordinating complex DTP and e-learning localization projects.
Advanced knowledge of multilingual publishing requirements, including Latin, Cyrillic, right-to-left (RTL), and Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) scripts, with practical delivery experience or a credible vendor coverage strategy.
Strong understanding of localization best practices, including translation-ready file preparation, text expansion management, font coverage, and linguistic review processes.
Proven ability to estimate production time and costs per file, language, and writing system, with clear assumptions and resource planning.
Expert-level proficiency in e-learning authoring tools, particularly Articulate Rise and Storyline.
Advanced technical skills with Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, and ideally FrameMaker.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, including document formatting and layout management.
Experience managing external DTP vendors, including task delegation, production briefings, deadline management, quality reviews, and feedback.
Ability to troubleshoot technical and formatting issues independently, anticipate potential challenges, and propose effective solutions.
Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate clearly in client-facing documentation, technical guidance, and internal project handoffs.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.
A proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset, with the confidence to challenge unrealistic requirements while maintaining a collaborative approach.
Familiarity with formatting and document production requirements for life sciences content is an advantage.

Additional Qualifications Considered a Plus

Experience working with Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD source files.
Familiarity with computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools and translation management systems, particularly file preparation and format round-tripping workflows.
Knowledge of automation techniques, including InDesign scripting, GREP styles, and data merge.
Understanding of PDF accessibility standards, tagging, and accessible document production.
Practical experience working with Thai or Indic writing systems.

Benefits

Six-month, full-time, fixed-term contract.
Fully remote working arrangement, offering location flexibility across Europe.
Opportunity to work on international multilingual localization and e-learning projects.
Hands-on involvement in a varied range of DTP, digital learning, and document production activities.
Opportunity to combine technical production expertise with project management and client-facing responsibilities.
Collaboration with internal teams and specialized external vendors in an international localization environment.
Opportunity to contribute to production best practices, workflow improvements, and quality standards.
Exposure to a diverse range of languages, scripts, industries, and localization technologies.
